title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Role**

We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior Cloud Engineer specializing in AWS and Terraform, with 6+ years of relevant experience, to join our dynamic and growing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing cloud-based solutions to meet our business needs.

**Responsibilities:-**

**Cloud Infrastructure Development and Management:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and secure cloud infrastructures on AWS.
* Implement and manage cloud environments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles, primarily utilizing Terraform.
* Automate cloud deployments and develop cloud-native applications.
* Use AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q Developer) to speed up Terraform, scripting and automation work

**Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD):**

* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for efficient and automated code deployments.
* Work closely with development teams to integrate cloud solutions into application deployment processes.

**Performance Monitoring and Optimization:**

* Monitor cloud resources for optimal performance and cost-effectiveness.
* Implement best practices for cloud security, scalability, and reliability.
* Use AI-driven monitoring and alerting to detect issues early, and track the cost and usage of AI workloads (GPU, token usage)

**Collaboration and Support:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their cloud requirements and provide technical guidance.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for cloud-related issues.

**Innovation and Research:**

* Stay updated with the latest cloud technologies and trends.
* Recommend and implement new cloud solutions and technologies to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Evaluate new AI services and build internal AI-based automations to improve team efficiency

**Qualifications:-**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in cloud engineering, with strong hands-on expertise in AWS.
* Proven experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, S3, VPC, Lambda, RDS, etc.).
* Strong experience in infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Experience in setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or similar.
* Knowledge of cloud security best practices and standards.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Eagerness to learn and adopt new AI tools

title: Associate - SRE - Platform Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
**Associate Platform Reliability Engineer (SRE)**
**Location:**
Mumbai / Pune
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly motivated
**Associate Platform Reliability Engineer (SRE)**
to join our global Platform Reliability Engineering team. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of critical front-to-back platforms supporting post-trade processing.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a strong software engineering foundation, production support experience, and a passion for automation, observability, and reliability engineering. You will work closely with development, infrastructure, and business teams to improve system resilience, enhance operational visibility, reduce manual intervention, and deliver highly available services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Proactively monitor platform health and drive improvements in reliability, performance, availability, and operational efficiency.
* Perform incident triage, troubleshooting, communication, and post-incident reviews to minimize business impact and prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to design and implement scalable and resilient solutions.
* Build and enhance deployment and observability capabilities, including dashboards, alerts, and service health monitoring using Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry.
* Analyze logs, metrics, and distributed traces to proactively identify system bottlenecks and reliability issues.
* Support enterprise messaging and event-driven architectures, including Kafka-based platforms and integrations.
* Apply capacity planning and availability management best practices to improve platform resilience.
* Develop automation to reduce operational toil, minimize manual intervention, and improve service efficiency.
* Participate in production support, problem management, release management, and change management activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 3+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Reliability Engineering (PRE), DevOps, Production Support, or Application Support.
* Strong programming and scripting experience in one or more languages such as Python, Go, or Java.
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and system design.
* Strong working knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows Server environments.
* Experience with modern monitoring and observability practices and tooling.
* Strong understanding of observability and reliability concepts, including metrics, logs, traces, SLIs, SLOs, and alerting.
* Good understanding of event-driven architectures and enterprise messaging platforms such as Kafka and MQ.
* Experience troubleshooting distributed production systems, including APIs, middleware components, and message flows.
* Understanding incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, and operational support processes.
* Familiarity with source control, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and DevOps practices.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders.
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Observability & Monitoring:**
Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry and Loki
  
  
**DevOps & Automation:**
Git, Ansible and CI/CD Frameworks
  
  
**Container & Platform Technologies:**
Docker, Kubernetes
  
  
**Data & Messaging Platforms:**
Kafka, Redis, MQ
  
  
**Cloud Technologies:**
AWS
  
  
**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
  
  
Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

title: MuleSoft Integrations Lead
description:
**Company Description**
The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.
  
  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Integration Team Lead is responsible for team activities concerning the design, development, and maintenance of the company's integration architecture. While strong proficiency in MuleSoft based integration architecture is highly valued, this role encompasses a broader, modern integration technology landscape, including MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Metering and Billing, n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps. This role acts as a subject matter expert on API-led and event-driven integration patterns, ensuring that all corporate systems integrations are scalable, reliable, and secure. The manager-as-engineer works closely with various cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications and leads the development team to deliver high-quality integration solutions.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibility**
Integration Architecture & Delivery:
  
  
Design, build, and maintain the company's central integration instances and solutions, leveraging MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Metering and Billing, n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps to ensure a high-performing digital ecosystem.
  
  
**Team Leadership & Mentoring**
Manage, mentor, and guide a team of integration engineers (including direct reports), fostering a collaborative, agile, and high-performance engineering culture.
  
  
**Collaboration & Requirements Engineering**
Partner with product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand business workflows, translate them into comprehensive integration designs, and manage delivery timelines.
  
  
**Best Practices & Standards**
Enforce strict coding standards, robust code review processes, API governance, and comprehensive automated testing guidelines within the team.
  
  
**DevOps & Platform Operations**
Oversee automated deployment pipelines (CI/CD), environment management, and proactive monitoring/alerting across all core integration platforms.
  
  
**Incident & Problem Management**
Guide the team in resolving critical integration-related incidents, performing root-cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent preventative fixes.
  
  
**DECISION-MAKING POWER**

* Owns technical and operational decisions related to the company's core integration, event streaming, and API platforms (including MuleSoft, Confluent Kafka, Kong API/AI Gateways, and automation tools).
* Defines task delegation, prioritization, and sprint planning within the Integration Team.
* Recommends integration architectural standards and platform governance policies to the Integration Competency Center Manager.

**Who Are We Looking For**

* Brings several years of hands-on experience in software development, systems engineering, and IT operations in general.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in software development or integration engineering, with at least 1-2 years in a team lead or coordinator role.
* In-depth, hands-on experience with APIs (designing, developing, deploying, and managing APIs across their entire lifecycle).
* In-depth knowledge and practical experience in designing and implementing RESTful APIs and modern event-driven streams.
* Strong practical knowledge and experience with enterprise integration tools:
* Enterprise iPaaS: Strong hands-on experience with MuleSoft (Anypoint Platform, CloudHub, API Manager).
* Event Streaming: Experience with Apache Kafka / Confluent Platform (producers, consumers, streaming concepts, topic management).
* API Gateways: Experience with Kong API Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, and Kong Metering and Billing.
* Automation & Lightweight iPaaS: Practical knowledge of n8n, MS Power Platform, and Azure Logic Apps.
* DevOps & Agile Methods:
* Confident experience with modern DevOps methods and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions).
* Solid understanding and practical experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, or scaled agile frameworks like SAFe).
* Familiarity with Waterfall project methodologies where hybrid planning is required.
* Proactivity and Autonomy: Ability to work independently and responsibly, proactively proposing optimizations for existing processes and systems.
* Team Spirit & Leadership: Strong interpersonal and leadership skills with proven experience in team management, fostering team cohesion, and resolving conflict.
* Language skills: Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Curiosity & Growth Mindset: Openness to learning and adopting emerging technologies.

**Qualifications**
**ELIGIBLITY**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* Proven experience in enterprise-grade integrations, platform operations, and technical team leadership.

**Additional Information**
#NemetschekIndia

* **Identity, devices and security:**
  Manage identity, MFA and every laptop centrally, and enforce security policies, access reviews and regular audits.
* **Data protection:**
  Protect engineering, customer and export-controlled data through data classification, access control and DLP.
* **Audit and compliance:**
  Keep audit-ready records, asset and vendor registers, and manage vendors to meet customer, government and defence requirements.
* **Security operations:**
  Run security logging and alerting, incident response, lost-device handling, IT ticketing and tested backup and disaster recovery.
* **Compute and AI infrastructure:**
  Set up and run GPU/CPU clusters (hardware, Linux, drivers, scheduling, storage) and plan on-premise vs cloud capacity.
* **Cloud and servers:**
  Own the Microsoft, Google and AWS environments, servers, backups and monitoring, and lead cloud vs on-premise decisions.
* **Procurement, assets and cost:**
  Own the IT budget, purchasing, licences and renewals, comparing vendor quotations before major spend.
* **Team and collaboration:**
  Build and lead the IT team, establish SOPs for all of IT, and advise leadership on hosting and the IT roadmap.

**Experience & Background**

* **8+ years in IT infrastructure, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior owner role**
  .
* **Proven track record of building an IT function from the ground up**
  : infrastructure, security, operations and administration,
  **with minimal support and a lean team**
  , taking it from ad hoc to documented, secure and scalable.
* **Has designed IT infrastructure end to end**
  (network, systems, cloud and security) and led its implementation.
* Has moved a device fleet to
  **central management (MDM)**
  , rolled out
  **MFA**
  , and
  **written and enforced security policies**
  .
* **Has set up or run compute clusters**
  : hardware, Linux, job scheduling and shared storage.
* **Has structured and hired an IT team.**
* **Has owned an IT budget**
  , managed licences and vendors,
  **compared vendor quotations**
  , and can show
  **savings with numbers**
  .
* Has
  **written SOPs and runbooks that others follow**
  , and kept them current.

**Core skills (required)**

* **Infrastructure architecture and design:**
  designing networks and systems end to end, including topology and segmentation, high availability and redundancy, capacity planning and sizing, cloud vs on-premise trade-offs, security by design, and clear architecture diagrams and documentation.
* **Networking fundamentals:**
  TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and inter-VLAN routing, NAT, QoS, ISP redundancy and failover.
* **Firewalls and remote access:**
  enterprise firewall administration (HA, policies, VPN, DNS and web filtering); ZTNA / secure remote access with device-posture checks.
* **Wireless and switching:**
  Aruba (or equivalent) controllers and access points, RF planning and tuning; Cisco (or equivalent) switching, stacking and VLANs.
* **Identity and access:**
  Active Directory and Group Policy; Entra ID, Okta or Google Workspace (SSO, SCIM, conditional access); MFA and passkeys; joiner-mover-leaver automation; access reviews.
* **Endpoint management and security:**
  MDM across Windows, Mac and Linux (e.g. Intune, Jamf); EDR; disk encryption with key escrow; privilege management; remote wipe.
* **Data protection:**
  DLP across endpoints, email and SaaS; data classification and handling; access control for sensitive and export-controlled data.
* **Cloud and productivity platforms:**
  Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration and licensing; Azure, AWS or Google Cloud (compute, storage, networking, identity, cost control); cloud and SaaS tenant security.
* **Servers and virtualization:**
  Windows Server and Linux administration; VMware, Hyper-V or Proxmox; HPE iLO and RAID; server health, patching and warranty.
* **Backup and recovery:**
  backup design, tested restores, BCP/DR planning with annual test evidence.
* **Compute infrastructure:**
  cluster server hardware (power, cooling, racks, cluster networking); Linux; job scheduling (e.g. SLURM), shared storage, user access and monitoring.
* **Security operations:**
  security policies and audits, security logging and alerting, vulnerability and patch management, incident response.
* **Monitoring and service management:**
  network and server monitoring (e.g. PRTG, Zabbix), ITSM ticketing, uptime and support SLAs.
* **Scripting and automation:**
  PowerShell, Bash/shell and Python; version control with Git.
* **Procurement and vendor management:**
  IT budgeting, vendor quotations, purchasing, licence management and renewals, vendor contracts, asset and vendor registers, total cost tracking.
* **Documentation:**
  SOPs, runbooks and network documentation (e.g. NetBox) that others can follow.

**Good to have:**

* **Full SASE / secure web gateway:**
  cloud-delivered web security and shadow-IT discovery.
* **SIEM and forensics:**
  full SIEM platform operations and incident forensics.
* **Compliance:**
  ISO 27001 / SOC 2 controls and evidence operations.
* **Infrastructure-as-code:**
  Terraform or similar.
* **GPU computing:**
  GPU servers, GPU drivers and CUDA, and supporting GPU workloads for simulation and AI teams.
* **Certifications (good to have, any of):**
  firewall vendor certification (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point), HPE Aruba Networking, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300) or Azure Administrator (AZ-104), or AWS/GCP equivalents, CompTIA Security+ or CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, ITIL 4. Equivalent hands-on experience counts equally.

title: Technical Graduate - Technology Engineer - Software, Cloud & Infrastructure 2027
description:
At CGI, we empower the next generation of innovators to shape the future of technology and security. As part of
**#GenerationCGI**
, you’ll join a community of graduates who are turning ambition into action and possibility into progress.
  
  
As a
**Technology Engineer - Software, Cloud & Infrastructure Graduate**
, you’ll help design, build, test and support the technology that organisations rely on. Depending on your project, you could be developing software, automating tests, engineering cloud platforms, supporting applications or helping manage secure and reliable infrastructure.
  
  
You’ll be trusted with responsibility from the start, working alongside experienced colleagues on live projects across a range of industries. You’ll develop broad technical experience while building deeper expertise in the technologies and areas that best match your strengths and career ambitions.
  
  
**Your Future Duties And Responsibilities**
In this role, you’ll use technology to solve real-world problems and deliver reliable services for CGI’s clients. The work will vary by project, giving you opportunities to develop experience across software engineering, testing, cloud technology, infrastructure, DevOps and technical support.
  
  
**You May**

* Develop software solutions: Design, build and maintain front-end, back-end or full-stack applications using modern programming languages, frameworks and development practices.
* Test and assure quality: Create and run manual or automated tests to help ensure that software is reliable, secure and meets user requirements.
* Engineer cloud platforms: Help design, configure and support scalable cloud environments using technologies such as AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Build and support infrastructure: Work with operating systems, networks, virtualisation, containers and platform services that underpin critical applications.
* Automate delivery: Apply DevOps and DevSecOps practices to improve build, testing, deployment and operational processes.
* Support live services: Investigate technical issues, monitor systems and help maintain the performance, availability and security of applications and platforms.
* Work with data and emerging technology: Contribute to projects involving data engineering, artificial intelligence, automation or other developing technologies.
* Collaborate with clients and colleagues: Work in multidisciplinary teams, communicate technical information clearly and help deliver solutions that meet client needs.
* Innovate alongside other graduates: Take part in early careers initiatives that go beyond your day-to-day role.

Every contribution you make will help deliver outcomes with lasting impact.
  
  
Locations
  
  
Opportunities are available in
**Aberdeen, Belfast, Bridgend, Bristol, Cardiff, Chippenham, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Gloucester, Leatherhead, Leeds, London, Manchester, Milton Keynes, Newcastle, Nottingham, Reading, the Scottish Borders and Sheffield**
.As CGI is a consultancy, you may be required to work from a CGI office or client site and occasionally travel to different locations. Flexibility and a willingness to travel are therefore important.
  
  
Why Join Us?
  
  
At CGI, you’ll be part of a culture that celebrates diversity, inclusion and collaboration, where your perspective is valued and your ideas contribute to meaningful outcomes.Your journey starts with a structured Early Careers Induction Programme, giving you the foundations to succeed, along with 24/7 e-learning and opportunities to gain professional certifications that build your expertise. You’ll also join our Student Kick-start Initiative, where you’ll collaborate with other graduates on creative projects that deliver impact beyond your day-to-day role.CGI is an unconditionally inclusive workplace where you are respected, your voice is heard and you can be yourself. We were recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We proudly hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant.
  
  
**Benefits**
Along with a competitive salary and a £1,000 joining bonus, you’ll enjoy benefits that support every stage of your journey. You’ll share in CGI’s success through our matched share scheme, have access to private healthcare, well-being programmes and professional training, and build financial security with a competitive pension. Beyond the day job, you’ll connect with others through graduate networks, diversity groups and social clubs that make your time at CGI both rewarding and enjoyable.
  
  
**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
We’re seeking technically curious graduates who enjoy solving problems and want to build technology that makes a real difference. You do not need experience in every area listed below. We’re interested in the technical strengths you already have, your willingness to learn and the direction in which you want to develop.
  
  
**You Should Have**

* A minimum 2:2 degree, normally in computer science, software engineering, information technology, computer engineering, mathematics, physics, cyber security or another relevant STEM subject. Some positions may accept other degree subjects where you can demonstrate strong technical ability, and some may require a 2:1.
* A genuine interest in software, cloud technology, infrastructure or supporting technical services.
* Strong analytical thinking and a practical approach to solving problems.
* The ability to work collaboratively and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality work.
* A willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to different projects and client environments.
* Flexibility to travel and work from CGI offices or client sites where required.
* Eligibility for Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance, with some positions requiring higher National Security Vetting. This may include additional residency or nationality requirements, which will be explained for the relevant role.

**Technical Skills We Value Include**

* Programming and scripting: Experience with one or more languages such as Java, C#, Python or JavaScript.
* Software engineering: An understanding of application development, full-stack development, APIs, microservices, web or mobile development.
* Software testing: An interest in quality assurance, test automation and building reliable software.
* Cloud technologies: Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure, cloud architecture or cloud-native development.
* DevOps and automation: Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible or related automation and delivery tools.
* Containers and platforms: An understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, virtualisation or platform engineering.
* Systems and infrastructure: Familiarity with Linux or Red Hat, systems administration, networking, infrastructure engineering or site reliability engineering.
* Data technologies: Exposure to SQL, data engineering, Databricks, Elastic or data modelling.
* Agile delivery: An understanding of Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira or Confluence.
* Emerging technology: An interest in artificial intelligence, generative AI, automation or other developing technologies would be beneficial.

**What You Can Expect From Us**
**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: SRE Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Reliability Engineer - DevSecOps
  
  
**Department**
: Markets IT - APS
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
Corporate and Institutional Banking has an active IT ecosystem with its own IT backbone that involves a large workforce of IT employees working for DEV, Testing and Support projects.
  
  
CIB ITO Production ensures the provision of industrialized and digital production services. The objective is to offer innovative products and services to its customers in a performing, global and secured environment in order to speed up delivery and time to market. CIB ITO Production manages operational risk by running stable and robust IT production platforms. CIB ITO production hosts critical service delivery scope comprising of Global Markets, Global Banking, Client & Employee, ALM&T, Regulatory & Control IT and BP2S.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The Senior Reliability Engineer is a technical powerhouse responsible for the stability and evolution of the DevSecOps platform. Unlike a traditional support role, this position requires a
**strong engineering mindset**
. The primary objective is to ensure production stability by treating every failure as a bug that requires a permanent code-based or architectural fix. The successful candidate will be a tech enthusiast who is equally comfortable navigating the nuances of AI-driven tools (Open Code, MCP) and the depths of the DevSecOps toolchain, ensuring that the platform is not just "running," but is resilient, scalable, and automated.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Root-Cause Engineering: Lead the investigation of complex production failures. Move beyond "restarting services" to identify the fundamental cause of issues and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence.
* Platform Stability & Coding: Proactively write and deploy code to enhance platform reliability. Use a development mindset to automate manual interventions and resolve technical debt within the toolchain.
* AI Operationalization: Support and optimize MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and internal AI-driven use cases. Understand the nuances of AI-specific configurations and keywords to ensure these services are performant and stable.
* Advanced Tool Administration: Provide expert-level administration and optimization of the DevSecOps stack, specifically Bitbucket, Artifactory, and Cloudbees Jenkins.
* Pipeline & Security Orchestration: Ensure the seamless integration of SonarQube, NexusIQ, and Fortify within the CI/CD pipelines, ensuring security gates are automated and reliable.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Manage platform components using Ansible, Kubernetes, and Docker, ensuring that environment configurations are versioned and reproducible.
* Toil Reduction: Identify repetitive manual tasks and engineer automation to reduce the ticket volume by the agreed target, shifting the team's focus from reactive support to proactive engineering.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Technical Mentorship: Guide junior engineers in adopting a "Reliability First" mindset and improving their capabilities for production fixes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Dev and Sec teams to refine the DevSecOps roadmap and integrate new tools (e.g., GitHub migration).
* Lifecycle Management: Participate in the strategic planning for tool upgrades and capacity management to ensure the platform scales with business growth.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Inquisitive Nature: A natural curiosity to ask "Why?" until the actual root cause is found. A refusal to accept "it's working now" as a completed task.
* Tech Enthusiasm: A passion for exploring new technologies and the drive to apply them to real-world production problems.
* Ownership & Accountability: A strong sense of ownership over the stability of the platform and the courage to take the lead in applying critical fixes.
* Analytical Rigor: Ability to decompose complex system failures into manageable engineering tasks.

**Specific Qualifications:**
NA
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential**
**(**
**Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Development Mindset: Strong proficiency in Python and Shell Scripting for production automation. Ability to read and modify code to apply fixes.
* DevSecOps Mastery: Admin-level knowledge of Bitbucket, Artifactory, and Cloudbees Jenkins. Experience with GitHub is highly preferred.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker in a production environment.
* Automation Frameworks: Proficiency in Ansible or similar framework for configuration management.
* Security Tooling: Familiarity with the operational side of SonarQube, NexusIQ, and Fortify or their market competitors.
* AI Awareness: Ability to manage and troubleshoot AI-enabled infrastructure, with a conceptual understanding of LLM interaction and Open Code environments.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Excellent Communications
* Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
* Ability to understand, explain & support change
* Attention to detail / rigor

**Education Level:**
Graduate & Above
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore (KA)
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporate and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work at the intersection of AI, engineering, product, and customers. You will understand real business workflows and turn ambiguous problems into working AI products using AI models, APIs, databases, MCP, and integrations. You won't just build features in isolation. You will take solutions from problem prototype integration to deployment and real-world usage. Responsibilities: - Build AI agents, workflows, APIs, and integrations for real enterprise use cases. - Understand customer workflows and translate business problems into technical solutions. - Take ambiguous requirements and turn them into working, deployed products. - Integrate Progent with customer databases, APIs, SaaS tools, and internal systems. - Work with LLMs, APIs, databases, webhooks, authentication, and MCP (Model Context Protocol). - Debug issues across code, data, APIs, AI models, and third-party systems. - Work directly with users and improve products based on real-world usage. - Make practical engineering decisions and move quickly without getting blocked by non-critical details. - Convert customer-specific implementations into reusable Progent capabilities. Requirements: - You enjoy building and shipping, not just learning concepts. - You have strong coding fundamentals and are comfortable writing code independently. - You understand basics such as APIs, HTTP, databases, SQL/queries, JSON, and integrations. - You have built at least one AI/LLM project at work, in college, during an internship, hackathon, or independently. - You are curious about technologies such as AI agents, tool calling, RAG, MCP, and workflow automation. - You enjoy solving unclear problems and figuring things out independently. - You can debug a problem across multiple systems rather than stopping at your part of the codebase. - You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - You take ownership from idea to deployment. - Strong personal projects, hackathons, internships, open-source contributions, or products you have built independently matter significantly. Good to Have: - Hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go, or similar languages. - Experience building or consuming REST APIs. - Familiarity with SQL and databases. - Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, or MCP. - Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms or APIs. - Familiarity with Git, Linux, Docker, cloud platforms, or deployment workflows. Company Summary Progent builds the operating brain for companies. We're an enterprise-first research lab. We turn the company's knowledge into custom models and deploy an agent workforce that reports to the company's teams. One that is specialized, owned by the client company, and always improving. The best companies don't scale on generalists. They scale on people who know their domain, their tools, and their culture. Hiring works that way. AI should too. Off-the-shelf models offer off-the-shelf agents. The real edge comes from agents trained on the client's data, tuned for their workflows, and owned by their organization. Building and running AI at scale is brutal. New architectures, new models, new papers every week. Most pilots die before production. Enterprises want to adopt AI without becoming AI companies. We integrate seamlessly with client companies and handle the complexity to ship outcomes. That's why Progent exists. Progent was founded on one belief: every company needs an AI partner, not another project. Early adopters got value from general models. The next wave is pulling ahead with agents built in-house, waiting on the next model drop, and not sharing the company's edge with the rest of the market. Our job is to absorb the complexity of modern AI and turn it into production-grade systems clients can trust. Most enterprise AI forces choosing between automating the predictable and handling the complex. We think that's the wrong trade-off. Real operations don't separate neatly. The work that matters most is where judgment and process are tangled together, where one needs reliability and intelligence in the same breath. We've built around that belief. The result is an AI workforce that doesn't just execute tasks but understands the shape of the business and gets better over time without them having to manage it like a software project.

title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  
  
Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
  
  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
* Liaising with internal teams & management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
  
  
People Management.
  
  
As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  
  
Incident Management.
  
  
You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.
  
  
Vendor Management.
  
  
An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.
  
  
Process Improvement.
  
  
You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
  
  
Health & Safety.
  
  
Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
* 3+ years of managing IT technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 4+ years of network and operating system support experience
* 1+ years of Agile methods and processes experience
* Experience in capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar
* Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
* Experience implementing change management successfully transitioning programs into large-scale operations

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

The

is a trusted technical advisor and primary account contact for key Dynatrace customers, accountable for platform success, adoption, and long-term value in complex, large-scale environments. This is a senior, enterprise-focused role that combines technical depth, business understanding, and account management. The TAM is the named owner of a defined set of Success deliverables, including platform health reviews, support case management, change window coverage, version lifecycle planning, and enhancement request advocacy, scaled to the customer’s support tier. The role is not support-centric or project-limited. It requires strong technical judgment, executive presence, and ownership across long-running engagements, and it operates at the highest tier of the Dynatrace Success offering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Success Planning: Maintain a success plan tied to customer business objectives and manage end-to-end service delivery.

* After-Hours & Event Support: Provide planned on-call coverage for critical moments such as major retail events and product launches, with reasonable advance notice.
* Cadenced Meetings: Lead recurring account and success meetings (weekly at Signature tier).

**What Will Help You Succeed**

* Deep, hands‑on technical expertise with the Dynatrace platform and enterprise observability architectures.
* Demonstrated experience supporting large, complex enterprise customers.
* Proven ability to define, communicate, and manage success plans, including clear milestones, dependencies, risks, and outcomes aligned to customer objectives.
* Strong understanding of modern application stacks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and cloud‑native technologies (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
* Proven ability to operate independently as a senior technical advisor in high‑visibility customer situations.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to executive audiences.
* Strong capability to coordinate and influence cross‑functional teams (Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, Product, Sales) without direct authority.
* Experience proactively identifying and managing program risks, escalation paths, and recovery plans in complex enterprise environments.
* Ability to balance strategic planning and hands‑on execution in high‑ambiguity, high‑visibility customer situations.
* Skilled in executive‑level program communication, including status reporting, expectation setting, and outcome‑based progress reviews (e.g., QBRs, steering meetings).
* Track record of driving accountability across stakeholders to ensure commitments are met and outcomes are delivered as planned.
* Demonstrated experience delivering within a structured, tiered customer success or support framework, with the ability to adapt engagement depth, meeting cadence, and deliverable scope to match contracted service levels.
* Experience owning case management and escalation resolution on behalf of enterprise customers, including trend analysis, cross-team coordination, and driving cases to closure within agreed SLAs.
* Proven ability to support customers through high-stakes production changes, upgrades, and maintenance windows, including cutover planning, real-time issue response, and post-change validation.
* Hands-on experience integrating observability platforms with ITSM and CMDB tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management), with a solid understanding of how enterprises change management processes operate in production environments.
* Prior experience acting as a long‑term technical owner for strategic accounts (Preferred).
* History of influencing outcomes across teams without formal authority (Preferred).
* Comfort operating in ambiguous or evolving role definitions (pilot or transformation experience) (Preferred).

**Why you will love being a Dynatracer**

* Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
* We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
* Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
* You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
* Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

title: Sr MLOps Engineer
description:
Senior MLOps Engineer

We are seeking an experienced Senior MLOps Engineer to build, deploy, and maintain secure,

scalable, and reliable machine learning infrastructure in production. In this role, you will work

closely with Data Science, Backend Engineering, and Product teams—as well as directly with

client stakeholders—to operationalize machine learning models and establish robust ML

engineering and deployment practices.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience across the end-to-end ML lifecycle,

with particular expertise in MLflow, model deployment, ML pipelines, CI/CD,

containerization, AWS infrastructure, model monitoring, and production reliability.

Key Responsibilities

• ML Model Deployment & Infrastructure: Design, deploy, containerize, and scale

machine learning models and inference services in production using Docker and AWS

services such as ECS, EKS, Lambda, and SageMaker.

• MLflow & Model Lifecycle Management: Build and maintain MLflow-based

workflows for experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, model

packaging, artifact management, and promotion of models across development,

staging, and production environments.

• ML Pipelines & Automation: Build and maintain automated ML pipelines covering

data preparation, model training, validation, experiment tracking, model registration,

deployment, and retraining.

• CI/CD & MLOps Automation: Develop CI/CD workflows that integrate MLflow with

model training and deployment pipelines. Implement automated testing, model

validation, artifact management, deployment strategies, and reliable rollback

mechanisms.

• Cloud Infrastructure: Design and manage production ML infrastructure on AWS,

including compute, networking, storage, IAM, monitoring, and other services required to

support machine learning workloads.

• Security & Access Control: Implement security best practices including least-privilege

IAM, secure secrets management, network isolation, encryption, role-based access

control, and appropriate controls for sensitive data and production ML systems.

• Model Monitoring & Observability: Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging,

metrics, and alerting for production ML systems. Monitor model performance, inference

latency, resource utilization, data quality, data drift, model drift, and system reliability.

• Data & Model Reproducibility: Establish robust practices for tracking datasets,

MLflow experiments, model versions, parameters, metrics, configurations, dependencies,

and deployment artifacts to ensure reproducibility and traceability.

• Production Reliability: Ensure ML services meet production requirements for

availability, scalability, performance, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.

MINDWISE TECHNOLOGIES PVT LTD

• Performance & Cost Optimization: Identify opportunities to optimize model inference,

compute resources, infrastructure architecture, and AWS costs while maintaining

production performance and reliability.

• Client Communication & Technical Ownership: Serve as a trusted technical voice

with clients, communicating infrastructure decisions, deployment architecture, security

practices, operational risks, and technical recommendations clearly and professionally.

Required Skills & Experience

• Experience: 4+ years of experience in MLOps, ML Engineering, DevOps, or a closely

related field, with hands-on experience deploying and operating machine learning

systems in production.

• MLflow: Strong hands-on experience with MLflow, including Experiment Tracking,

MLflow Projects, Model Registry, model versioning, artifact management, model

packaging, and deployment workflows. Candidates should have used MLflow as part

of a production or near-production MLOps environment.

• Machine Learning Lifecycle: Strong understanding of the end-to-end machine learning

lifecycle, including data preparation, model training, validation, experiment tracking,

model registration, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and model lifecycle management.

• Python & SQL: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience building

production-grade services, automation scripts, and ML pipelines.

• Cloud Infrastructure (AWS): Deep hands-on experience with AWS services such as

IAM, VPC, S3, ECS/EKS, Lambda, CloudWatch, and preferably SageMaker.

• Containerization & Orchestration: Strong experience with Docker and

Kubernetes/EKS for deploying and managing production ML workloads.

• CI/CD: Strong experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins,

or equivalent, preferably with experience integrating MLflow into CI/CD workflows.

• ML Pipelines & Workflow Orchestration: Experience building automated ML

workflows using tools such as Airflow, Kubeflow, Prefect, or similar technologies.

• Model Monitoring & Observability: Experience implementing production monitoring,

logging, metrics, and alerting using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana,

Elasticsearch, or equivalent.

• Database & Data Systems: Good understanding of relational databases, data pipelines,

data storage, and infrastructure required to support production machine learning

workloads.

• Security: Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, secrets management, network

security, access controls, and secure handling of sensitive data.

• Professional Standards: High sense of ownership, strong problem-solving ability,

security-first mindset, attention to reliability, and excellent client-facing communication

skills.

Good to Have

• Experience with Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect, or similar ML/workflow orchestration

platforms.

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability
  
  
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Kabuni**

Kabuni is a sports technology company combining AI, biomechanics and sports science to make high-quality coaching more accessible. Starting with cricket, we’re building tools and pathways to help players develop their skills and reach their potential.Through the Kabuni Premier League (KPL), we’re creating opportunities for young cricketers to progress through auditions, training camps and franchise teams, connecting grassroots talent with structured player development.

**Role purpose**

Build, operate and maintain, secure, scalable infrastructure with automated delivery pipelines that support Kabuni’s software applications. Make repeatable provisioning, reliable releases, security controls and database maintenance part of the platform from the outset across Development, UAT and Production. The role centres on hands-on engineering, constructing agentic workflows, reducing manual operations and improving reliability as applications grow.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Agentic Pipeline Construction**

* Design and build agentic workflows for approved delivery and operational tasks, such as release management, test orchestration and security/maintenance recommendations.
* Integrate workflows with existing or new repositories, CI/CD pipelines and other operational tools.

**Identity and access**

* Manage Microsoft Entra ID onboarding, role changes and offboarding following approved requests; maintain accounts, security groups and application permissions.
* Apply least-privilege access and maintain an auditable record of approvals, access reviews and removals; escalate inappropriate or overdue access.

**Repositories and deployment pipelines**

* Administer Azure DevOps projects, repositories, branch policies and permissions in agreement with engineering leads.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration and deployment automation; diagnose failed builds and releases.
* Maintain deployment records, approval gates and rollback procedures; support production releases and post-release checks.

**Azure infrastructure and cost control**

* Provision and maintain Azure infrastructure, networking, virtual machines and environment access across Development, UAT and Production.
* Use Terraform and version-controlled Infrastructure as Code for repeatable provisioning and controlled changes.
* Monitor capacity, availability and cloud costs; identify waste and recommend improvements within approved budgets.
* Maintain infrastructure inventories, configuration documentation and recovery procedures; coordinate recovery testing with engineering owners.

**Embedded and machine-learning deployment support**

* Coordinate infrastructure, pipelines and environment readiness for embedded application deployments with the embedded engineering team.
* Provision infrastructure and maintain deployment pipelines for ML workloads, working with MLOps and backend engineers.
* Resolve infrastructure and deployment issues; ensure release packages and operational handovers are documented.

**Monitoring, security and operational support**

* Maintain monitoring, logs and actionable alerts for infrastructure, pipelines and supported services.
* Investigate incidents, coordinate restoration and communicate impact, progress and follow-up actions to the relevant technology owners.
* Maintain secure deployment configuration and secrets handling; escalate security concerns promptly through the agreed process.
* Keep operational runbooks current and document recurring issues, fixes and preventative improvements.

**Ownership and working relationships**

The role owns cloud infrastructure operation, access administration and deployment automation within approved standards. Engineering leads own application code, embedded software and model behaviour; QA owns test evidence; the designated product or release owner approves business readiness and production release. Access owners approve permissions before implementation.

Work closely with backend, embedded, ML, QA and product teams. Give the Programme Office clear updates on dependencies, risks and release readiness. Finance and the designated budget owner approve additional spending. The role does not authorise its own access requests or unapproved cloud expenditure.

**Skills and experience**

* We’re looking for a DevOps professional with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, cloud operations and deployment automation.
* Practical experience engineering and operating Azure infrastructure, networking and Microsoft Entra ID access controls.
* Hands-on Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD and Terraform experience, including reusable modules, automated testing, controlled releases and recovery.
* Strong scripting and API integration skills for reliable automation, using languages appropriate to the environment, such as Python, PowerShell or Bash.
* Experience building and evaluating AI agent workflows with tool integration, bounded permissions, human approval gates and operational monitoring. Ability to recognise when deterministic automation is the safer or simpler choice.
* Experience with vulnerability remediation, patch automation, secrets management, encryption, secure configuration and least-privilege access.
* Practical database operations experience covering backups and restore testing, migrations, patching, performance monitoring and data lifecycle controls.
* Ability to troubleshoot production incidents, explain operational trade-offs, document decisions and coordinate changes across engineering teams.
* Desirable experience includes embedded or ML deployment infrastructure, scaling cloud applications and policy-driven automation. Azure or Terraform certification is useful but not essential.

Please apply via this LinkedIn advert. For any enquiries, contact careers@kabuni.com.

* 2-4 years of hands-on experience building AI/ML solutions in a production or near-production environment
* Strong proficiency in Python – you write clean, production-grade code, not just notebooks
* Working experience with LLMs and generative AI: prompt engineering, RAG architecture, agentic workflows, or conversational AI systems
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and data warehouses
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS strongly preferred – Bedrock, Lambda, S3, Redshift, ECS/EKS)

* Understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and working with messy, imperfect enterprise data
* Strong communication skills – ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

**Strong Plus:**

* Experience with vector databases and knowledge graphs
* Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock
* Experience building multi-system integrations across enterprise platforms
* Exposure to AI governance: audit logging, RBAC, confidence scoring, human-in-the-loop workflows, hallucination prevention
* Experience with MCP or similar tool-use protocols

**Responsibilities:**
**Agentic AI Development**

* Design, build, and iterate on agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LanGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration tools
* Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that ground LLM responses in approved enterprise data sources with source citation, confidence scoring, and traceability
* Build and maintain multi-agent systems that decomposes complex operational questions into sub-tasks, query structured/unstructured data, and synthesize actionable outputs
* Implement prompt engineering, prompt libraries, and evaluation harnesses to ensure response quality, accuracy, and governance compliance
* Integrate with enterprise LLMs (e.g. AWS Bedrock / Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) and manage model abstraction layers for flexibility

**Enterprise Data Integration & Engineering**

* Build connectors and data pipelines to ingest and query data across different operational systems
* Develop and maintain semantic layers, knowledge graphs, and vector databases for contextual retrieval
* Implement data quality checks, trusted-source hierarchies, and conflict resolution logic when multiple systems provide contradictory data

**ML/AI Solutions & Analytics**

* Build and deploy ML models for predictive maintenance, performance optimization, anomaly detection, and operational forecasting

* Apply statistical methods to identify patterns, root causes, and actionable insights from fleet and service data

**Collaboration & Scaling AI Adoption**

title: Weblogic Administrator
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai

24×7 shifts and weekend support as required

**About the Company/Team**

Join Oracle in supporting mission-critical database, application and middleware environments. The role works across infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to maintain service availability, improve performance and support cloud migration and operational automation.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an Oracle Apps DBA & Fusion Middleware Administrator to manage, maintain and troubleshoot Oracle Applications, Database and Fusion Middleware environments. You will support production operations, upgrades, high availability, disaster recovery and cloud infrastructure.

Candidates should bring strong expertise in either Oracle Apps DBA or Fusion Middleware administration, supported by good working knowledge of the other.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Manage reliable production environments:**
  Administer Oracle Database, Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Fusion Middleware products, including WebLogic, SOA and OBIEE, across standalone, clustered and multi-node environments.
* **Deliver controlled lifecycle changes:**
  Install, configure, patch, clone, refresh and upgrade application, database and middleware platforms, including Oracle Database upgrades to 19c. Coordinate changes across technology teams.
* **Maintain availability and disaster readiness:**
  Support RAC, Active Data Guard, physical and snapshot standby databases, switchover, failover and disaster recovery synchronization using RSYNC across data centers.
* **Administer middleware services and deployments:**
  Configure JDBC connection pools, data sources, JMS resources and one-way/two-way SSL. Deploy and migrate WAR, EJB and EAR applications using WebLogic Console, deployment utilities and WLST.
* **Resolve incidents and improve performance:**
  Troubleshoot complex production issues, optimize WebLogic and database performance, assess capacity, manage planned downtime and restore services within committed SLAs.
* **Automate operational activities:**
  Use Python and shell scripting to standardize server and service management, reduce manual effort and prevent recurring incidents.
* **Support cloud environments and migrations:**
  Provision and maintain cloud infrastructure and migrate on-premises Oracle environments to OCI, applying sound networking, security, resilience and connectivity practices.

• •
**Coordinate effective service delivery:**
Work independently with customers and cross-functional teams, manage operational risks and changes, follow applicable compliance requirements and provide proactive technical recommendations.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Mandatory**

* Meet one of the following education and experience pathways:
* 11 years of experience implementing or supporting IT solutions, IT operations or related work;
  **or**
* A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, with 7 years of relevant experience;
  **or**
* A master’s degree in a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.
* Demonstrate hands-on Oracle Applications, Database and/or Fusion Middleware administration experience, with strong expertise in Apps DBA or Fusion Middleware and working knowledge of the other.
* Experience installing, configuring, administering and supporting Oracle infrastructure in production environments.
* Knowledge of Oracle Applications 11i/R12 administration, cloning, refreshes, patching and multi-node maintenance.
* Experience with WebLogic architecture, vertical and horizontal clustering, load balancing, high availability, patching and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting Oracle Database high availability and disaster recovery technologies, including RAC and Data Guard.
* Hands-on knowledge of JDBC, JMS, application deployment, SSL configuration and WLST.
* Strong Linux/Unix administration, Python and shell scripting skills.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, OCI provisioning and migration of on-premises Oracle environments to OCI.
* Ability to troubleshoot across infrastructure, database, middleware and application layers and support services within agreed SLAs.
* Strong communication, coordination, organizational and customer-facing skills, with attention to detail and the ability to work independently.
* Willingness to work 24×7 shifts and weekends as required.

**Good-to-Have**

* OCI certification, Oracle Product Certifications or other relevant technical certifications.
* Knowledge of Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager.
* Experience provisioning or maintaining environments on Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Docker and container orchestration technologies.
* Project management certification, including Certified Associate in Project Management.
* Experience contributing to solution architecture, project delivery or cross-functional programs.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

1. Can I independently administer and troubleshoot either Oracle Apps DBA or Fusion Middleware environments, while demonstrating practical working knowledge of the other?
2. Can I explain a production patching, cloning or upgrade activity I completed, including validation, rollback planning and downtime management?
3. Have I supported RAC, Data Guard or middleware clustering, and can I describe my role in a failover, switchover or disaster recovery exercise?
4. Can I demonstrate how I diagnosed a complex production issue or used Python, shell scripting or WLST to reduce recurring incidents and manual effort?
5. Do I meet an education and experience pathway, have relevant OCI provisioning or migration experience, and feel comfortable supporting customer environments through shifts and weekend work?
