title: Tech Lead, AI Engineering (SDE3)
description:
Pepper is the agentic organic growth platform that gets brands recommended and bought across humans and AI agents. Atlas, our engine, is live today: hundreds of agents, deterministic tasks, and monitors run the full organic-growth loop, with ~80% of delivery automated and climbing. ARR is up ~3x in the last year across 150 enterprise customers. This role builds the engine behind that.

**The role.**

* A senior, hands-on engineer who also leads: you write the hard code and set the technical bar for a small pod.
* Own agent workflows end to end, from data and orchestration to the API and the UI that surfaces them.
* Turn fuzzy LLM capability into reliable, production-grade systems that customers pay for on outcomes.
* Move fast: ship, measure, harden, repeat.

**What you will build.**

* Agentic workflows on Atlas: multi-step agents, tool use, and orchestration that run hundreds of tasks reliably and cheaply.
* The full stack around them: backend services and data pipelines, APIs, and the product surfaces that expose agent output.
* The reliability layer: evals, monitors, and guardrails so agents stay accurate and safe without a human checking every output.
* The judgment calls on where LLMs belong versus deterministic code, and how to keep latency and cost in check at scale.
* New automation that moves more of the delivery loop from humans to agents.

**Who you are.**

* 6+ years building production software, with real full-stack range (backend-heavy, comfortable across the stack).
* Has shipped LLM or agentic features to production, not demos: RAG, tool-calling agents, orchestration, or similar.
* Strong systems and data fundamentals; writes clean, well-tested code and raises the bar for others.
* Has led a small team or project technically, through design, review, and delivery.
* Pragmatic about AI: knows when to use a model and when not to, and how to make non-deterministic systems reliable.
* Thrives in a fast, high-ownership environment and wants to build the category-defining platform.

**Nice to have.**

* Experience with eval and observability tooling for LLM systems.
* SEO, GEO, MarTech, or other domain-heavy B2B product experience.
* Early-stage or 0 to 1 background.

title: AI Product Engineer - SSE
description:
AI Product Engineer (SSE)

Discovr AI | Mumbai

Screening Form: Please take a few minutes to fill out the application form below. This will help us understand your experience and profile better and fast-track your application.

Application Link: https://forms.gle/gRXHnnquvcpB3WZt8

About Discovr AI

Discovr AI is an AI-native creator advertising company, rethinking how influencer and creator marketing gets executed at scale.

We started with the manual work inside every creator campaign and built AI agents for Brand Safety, Script Review and Content Review. That was V1. It proved the foundation, and the business scaled with it across finance, FMCG, D2C and education in India. Now we’re expanding into the US, where we’re building a growing client base.

What we’re building next is far more ambitious: a vertical AI system where a brand states its product, objective, budget, timeline and guardrails, and Discovr AI progressively takes over the execution. Not another tool for brand managers to operate, but a system that does a large part of the work an influencer marketing team does today, with humans supervising the decisions that matter.

The role

We’re hiring an AI Product Engineer to build this from scratch. You’ll own problems end to end: figure out what needs to be built, design it, ship it and make it work reliably for real brands, real creators and real money. This is a high-ownership role. You’ll be handed problems, not tickets.

Experience: 2/3+ years

What you’ll do

* Take problems from idea to architecture, implementation, deployment, evaluation and iteration
* Build agents that use tools, context and multi-step workflows to run real campaign tasks
* Orchestrate multiple agents into one system with memory, permissions, retries, confidence thresholds and human approval
* Define how agent output is evaluated, investigate failures and fix them
* Build observability, guardrails and feedback loops around actions that affect brands, creators and money
* Balance quality, latency and cost in production
* Turn historical campaign decisions and outcomes into an intelligence layer that makes every new campaign smarter
* Work with product and business teams to turn customer needs in India and the US into shipped features

Scope

* You own products end to end, with architecture and scope decisions made by you
* Agent systems range from single-agent workflows to multi-agent setups, chosen on what the problem needs, not complexity for its own sake
* Your work reaches paying customers, and success is measured on reliability, usefulness and business outcomes
* You shape the product as it scales from India into a US AI SaaS offering

What we’re looking for

* 2/3+ years of experience at a product-based B2B SaaS or AI startup, building software used by real customers
* Hands-on experience building and shipping AI agents (tool use, context handling, multi-step workflows), beyond basic API integrations or chatbot wrappers
* Experience taking a product from idea to production, including testing and evaluation
* The ability to explain what you personally built, why you chose that approach and the trade-offs you made
* Strong problem-solving skills and a genuine love for building products

Tech and skills

* Python and strong backend fundamentals: APIs, async processing, queues, databases

title: Lead Technical Onboarding Engineer
description:
**About Neo4j**
Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
  
  
Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
  
  
**Our Vision**
At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
  
  
As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
  
  
**About The Job**
You will play a critical, hands-on role in guiding enterprise customers through the foundational stages of their deployment journey. As a
**player-coach and technical anchor for a focused four-person onboarding team**
, you will split your time between directly delivering complex customer onboardings and serving as the day-to-day technical escalation point and mentor for three fellow engineers.
  
  
Sitting at the intersection of technical architecture and customer delivery, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production-ready ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, steering customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.
  
  
For fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self-managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deploy secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Hands-on Technical Onboarding (~70–80%)**

* Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to define success criteria, milestones, architecture patterns, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Guide the provisioning of Neo4j AuraDB environments and self-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, and peering.
* Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption-at-rest protocols, and enforce least-privileged access through enterprise SSO (OIDC/SAML) and RBAC configurations.
* Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise customer development teams on Neo4j driver optimisation, connection pooling, and retry logic.
* Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools (logs and metrics) and deliver best-practice guidance on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
* Produce high-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and runbooks—to ensure smooth operational handoffs.

**Technical Mentorship & Team Escalation (~20–30%)**

* Serve as the senior technical point of escalation for the onboarding team, unblocking colleagues on complex customer architectures and troubleshooting edge-case issues.
* Pair with and mentor team members through design reviews, architecture discussions, and customer engagements to continuously elevate collective technical execution.
* Help balance day-to-day account coverage across the team to maintain consistent onboarding velocity and delivery quality.
* Synthesise field insights, lessons learned, and reusable blueprints to iterate and optimise our core onboarding methodologies, tooling, and onboarding automation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.g., Onboarding Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Platform Engineering, or Technical Consulting), with informal or formal experience acting as a technical lead, mentor, or escalation point.
* Proven track record of operating in a hands-on "player-coach" capacity—comfortable rolling up your sleeves on implementation while guiding peers.
* Hands-on experience architecting and deploying production workloads in at least one major cloud ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Deep technical proficiency in core enterprise networking (VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints).
* Demonstrated experience configuring Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, alongside configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible).
* Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container services).
* Hands-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j) and proficiency in query performance tuning (e.g., Cypher optimisation).
* Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk) and enterprise data integration/ETL/CDC tools.
* Exposure to cloud compliance standards (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and multi-region/data residency deployment patterns.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
**FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER - INDIA**
You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar.
  
  
****RESPONSIBILITIES:****

* Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics
* Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org
* Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs
* Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever
* Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption
* Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products

****BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:****

* You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science
* You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path)

****PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:****

* 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders
* Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo
* Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
  
  
You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long-term, trusted relationships.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go-to-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.

* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go-to-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.

**About The Team**
The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go-to-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.

title: Staff Engineer - Platform
description:
**About SolarSquare :**

At SolarSquare we are building the Home-Energy brand of future India. We help homes switch to rooftop solar and move away from traditional coal electricity. We are a full-stack D2C residential solar brand - designing, installing, maintaining (after-sales), and financing solar systems for home-owners across India.

In a few short years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service, and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission.

**About the role :**

As a Staff Engineer on Platform, you own the developer and infrastructure platform the entire engineering org builds on - cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and the internal tooling that eliminates mundane, repeated work. You set the direction for how we run software at scale, and you stay hands-on doing it.

**What you'll own :**

- Design and operate a cloud-native platform (Kubernetes-based) and the paved-road tooling teams build on.

- Own CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and developer experience - automate the mundane so engineers focus on impact.

- Drive reliability and SRE practices : observability, incident response, and root-cause fixes that stick.

- Optimize for performance, cost, and security as first-class concerns across the platform.

- Build internal developer-platform capabilities and standards that make the right way the easy way; mentor across pods.

**Tech Stack :**
We run on AWS with Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Redis, and Kafka.

**What we're looking for :**

- 8+ years in platform, infrastructure, or SRE roles, with deep distributed-systems fundamentals.

- Expertise in cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes), CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.

- Strong observability and reliability practice across service boundaries; you measure, then improve.

- A track record building internal platforms or developer tooling that others adopt.

- Attention to performance, cost, and security as first-class concerns.

- Customer-obsessed and impact-led : you start from the customer's pain and judge yourself by the metric your work moves, not the tickets you close.

- High agency : you don't wait to be told - you spot problems, pick them up, and own the outcome through to production.

- Craft over shortcuts : you fix root causes rather than symptoms, clear tech debt as you go, and don't ship bugs.

- Bias for speed and simplicity : you build once for reuse, automate the mundane, and let AI draft the first pass so your judgment goes where it matters.

- Data-driven : you reach for evidence over assumptions and let results guide the next decision.

**Bonus points :**

- Experience with internal developer platforms (IDP), self-service infrastructure, or DevEx initiatives.

- Cost-optimization or large-scale reliability engineering experience.

- Comfort building automation and agents that remove operational toil.

**Why you'll love building here :**

- Direct ownership of high-impact initiatives with visible customer and business outcomes.

- An AI-native engineering culture with first-class tooling and internal agents.

- A high-agency, low-bureaucracy environment where you debate what's right and ship.

- A meritocracy where growth and recognition track impact, not tenure.

- Competitive compensation.

- A front-row seat to putting clean energy on millions of Indian rooftops.

title: Platform & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Lead Platform & Infrastructure Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of our infrastructure, right from the bare-metal hardware and hypervisor layers up to container orchestration and application delivery.

In this role, you will act as the technical anchor for our architecture, automation, security, and day-to-day IT operations across virtualized and on-premise/bare-metal environments. You will be responsible for building a hardened, production-ready Kubernetes cluster from the ground up, implementing zero-trust network security, managing storage solutions, and driving automated CI/CD pipelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Systems & Virtualization Engineering:**

* Provision, tune, and manage bare-metal hosts and Linux-based virtual machines (VMs).
* Drive the shift from manual configurations to declarative Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management.
* Perform L3 troubleshooting across physical servers, guest OS, and virtualized storage volumes.

**Network Security & Access Management:**

* Architect, scale, and maintain secure mesh overlay networks and point-to-point VPNs.
* Implement least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and identity-aware routing across hosts, developer endpoints, and infrastructure tiers.
* Debug end-to-end network connectivity, routing partitions, MTU mismatches, and firewall/access control issues in hybrid setups.

**Production Kubernetes (K8s) Architecture & Hardening:**

* Design, bootstrap, secure, and operate high-availability (HA), production-grade Kubernetes clusters on self-managed infrastructure.
* Enforce strict InfoSec baselines: cluster RBAC, secret management/rotation, runtime security, admission controllers, and pod-to-pod network policies.
* Architect highly durable persistent storage solutions, integrate Container Storage Interface (CSI) drivers, and manage volume encryption, snapshots, and Disaster Recovery (DR).

**Observability, Monitoring & SRE:**

* Deploy and scale a comprehensive, full-stack observability platform for metrics, distributed tracing, and centralized log aggregation.
* Instrument proactive alerting, health checks, and dashboards across hosts, hypervisors, and container workloads to drastically reduce MTTR.

**CI/CD & DevSecOps Implementation:**

* Build, optimize, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines for seamless delivery of both application and infrastructure code.
* Integrate automated security checkpoints (Shift-Left security), including container image scanning, vulnerability assessments, and policy-as-code validations.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* **Educational Background:**
  B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, IT, MCA, or related field.
* **Core Experience:**
  7+ years of hands-on, progressive experience in DevOps, Systems Engineering, SRE, or Platform Engineering.

**Required Skills**

* **Linux Mastery:**
  Deep internal knowledge of Linux OS, kernel tuning, networking primitives, block devices, and file systems.
* **Bare-Metal & Private Cloud:**
  Proven capability in deploying, securing, and maintaining self-managed hypervisors and virtualization ecosystems natively (without reliance on public cloud managed services).
* **Self-Hosted Kubernetes:**
  Extensive hands-on experience bootstrapping and troubleshooting production-grade bare-metal/on-prem K8s clusters (managing control planes, etcd quorums, CNI plugins, CSI drivers, and Ingress).
* **Networking & Security:**
  Strong grasp of encrypted overlay networks, modern VPN protocols, SDN, and advanced firewalling. Practical experience with zero-trust architectures, mTLS, credential management, and workload isolation.
* **Automation/IaC:**
  Expert-level proficiency in automating infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience setting up and managing GitOps-driven workflows for cluster and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Hands-on expertise with configuring distributed, clustered, or networked storage backends for container ecosystems.

title: Agentic AI Builder
description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today, our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We are optimists for change, and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation.

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our consultants serve clients worldwide from offices in many countries. Our AI and Data teams combine data science, generative AI, and engineering to take solutions from proof of concept to large-scale deployment.

Our Mumbai office launched in 2024. We are building the team with people who want to shape something from the ground up, combining the agility of a start-up with the backing and reach of a global brand. The AI Factory in Mumbai builds and delivers production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients across North America, Europe and the Middle East.

**Job Description**

Generative AI is moving from assistants that answer questions to agents that do work. The Agentic AI Builder designs, builds and industrialises AI agents and multi-agent workflows for Sia's enterprise clients, and helps users adopt them. You will turn real business processes into agents that perform reliably in production.
  
  
This is agent engineering, not prompt writing or chatbot configuration. You will work with Forward Deployed Engineers, architects, consultants, and client teams, and you are expected to reason about orchestration, state, tools, evaluation, security, and cost, and to show with tests and measurements that an agent works.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work with consultants and business teams to identify agent use cases and translate business processes into clear agent requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Design agent architectures for business workflows, deciding when a single agent, a multi-agent pattern or a deterministic workflow with LLM steps is the right choice.
* Implement orchestration, tool calling and control flow in Python using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, the Claude Agent SDK or OpenAI SDK, or custom code where that is the better choice.
* Build tools and connectors to enterprise APIs and data sources, including MCP servers, with clear schemas, error handling and permissioning.
* Engineer context deliberately: retrieval over enterprise data, prompt and context design, and state and memory management across steps and sessions.
* Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints for approvals, escalation and exception handling.
* Create evaluation suites covering task success, tool-use correctness, regressions and adversarial cases, and use them to guide each release.
* Add observability, including traces, token and cost tracking and failure analytics, and optimise for reliability, latency and cost.
* Implement guardrails such as input and output validation, scoped credentials, prompt-injection defenses, and data-access controls.
* Work in agile, iterative cycles: estimate effort, flag risks and dependencies early, run solution demonstrations, and document agent behaviour and limits.
* Prepare agents for production with the FDE and architecture team, including deployment, monitoring, and operational handover.

**Internal Contributions**
  
As part of the AI Factory, you will also:

* Package reusable tools, connectors, and agent patterns that speed up later projects.
* Contribute to internal accelerators, demonstrations, and proposals.
* Share knowledge on agent design, evaluation, and guardrails with the wider engineering team.

**Qualifications**

**Education and experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 to 6 years of software or AI engineering experience.
* At least one agent or LLM workflow delivered beyond proof of concept, with evidence of how it was tested and measured.
* Professional English, written and spoken.

**Technical skills (required)**

* Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, packaging, typing and asynchronous programming.
* Hands-on experience building agents with tool calling and orchestration using at least one agent framework or SDK (LangGraph, LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI SDK or equivalent). Experience with every named framework is not expected.
* Understanding of agent state, memory and control flow, including retries, timeouts and failure recovery.
* Practical experience with RAG and vector search, and with context and prompt engineering as part of a larger system.
* Experience evaluating LLM and agent behaviour with test sets, automated checks or LLM-as-judge methods.
* Familiarity with LLM observability and tracing, and with tracking cost and latency.
* Experience integrating agents with enterprise APIs, databases or SaaS applications.
* Awareness of agent-specific risks, including prompt injection, excessive tool permissions and data leakage, and how guardrails address them.
* Cloud deployment fundamentals: containers, environment configuration and CI/CD.

**Consulting and collaboration**

* Ability to explain technical decisions and limits clearly to engineers, architects, and non-technical colleagues. Comfort running solution demonstrations and gathering feedback from business users.
* Ownership of the components you build and the ability to work with geographically distributed teams.

**Good to have**

* Working knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including building or hosting an MCP server.
* Experience with multi-agent patterns such as planner and executor, supervisor, or handoff designs.
* Experience with automation platforms such as n8n or Microsoft Copilot Studio alongside code-first approaches.
* Exposure to model routing, fine-tuning, or model selection trade-offs.
* FastAPI or other backend service experience; Kubernetes and infrastructure as code basics.Experience in a regulated sector or collaboration with international teams and clients.

**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to work on production AI for global enterprise clients, as part of a growing AI engineering capability.
* The chance to learn through real client implementations and to build reusable agent assets for the AI Factory.
* Access to Sia's leadership and training programmes as you grow.
* A collaborative, multidisciplinary team working across varied projects and industries.

**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)
  
  
  
  
Equal Opportunity**

Experience

Personal Attributes

Job Location - Ghansoli / Thane, Mumbai - deployed at client site

Hands-on DevOps Tower Lead for deployment with a leading private-sector banking client. Primary accountability: on-premises enterprise application infrastructure, container platforms and deployment operations. * Manage Kubernetes/OpenShift clusters, Linux infrastructure, container registries and related configuration in on-premises environments.

* Lead a technical tower, coordinate delivery and troubleshoot complex issues through resolution.
* AWS- Lead Kubernetes/OpenShift or AWS container deployment patterns, cloud configuration and infrastructure automation.

* Jenkins, Git, Ansible and Terraform; automated CI/CD pipelines
* Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift and Linux administration
* Monitoring/observability, incident response, security controls and vulnerability remediation

and

• Provide clear, concise executive incident summaries and technical updates during and immediately after service disruptions.

• Own end-to-end Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports, ensuring preventive and corrective actions are tracked to closure with software engineering teams.

**C. Advanced Technical Diagnostics & Systems Optimization**

• Guide the team through complex L3 debugging across distributed microservices, Java application stacks, and messaging queues (Kafka / RabbitMQ).

• Lead deep-dive log analysis, performance profiling, thread dump analysis, and database query optimization (Oracle, PostgreSQL).

• Oversee API stability, reviewing recurring integration failures across REST, SOAP, and ISO 8583 payment messaging protocols.

• Partner with engineering application owners to evaluate production readiness for new software releases, architectural changes, and gateway migrations.

**D. Observability, Automation & DevOps Maturity**

• Architect and refine centralized telemetry and logging platforms using ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) and Grafana/Prometheus.

• Drive automated alerting strategies to minimize false positives, detect systemic anomalies early, and enforce alert threshold discipline.

• Champion operational automation using Bash, Python, and CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI) to eliminate repetitive manual operational tasks.

• Supervise containerized application health and orchestration across Docker and Kubernetes clusters.

• Education: B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc in Computer Science, Information Technology, or allied technical disciplines.

• Technical Leadership: Proven track record of leading 24x7 technical support or reliability teams in FinTech, BFSI, Payment Gateways, or high-throughput transaction systems.

title: Platform Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)
description:
**Role Title:**
Platform Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)

**Department:**
Product Engineering

**Location:**
Mumbai / Pune (Onsite)

**Reports To:**
Engineering Manager

**Experience:**
5+ years, hiring across levels. Level is set by what you can own end to end, not by years on a resume.

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Scitara:**
Scitara is a global leader in digital transformation for scientific laboratories, enabling connectivity, automation, and data integrity across instruments, applications, and enterprise systems. Our cloud-based DLX platform is used by the world's top pharma, biotech, life sciences, and industrial R&D labs to modernize workflows and accelerate scientific outcomes. Lab informatics is growing 50 to 70% over the next five years, at the exact moment AI is being layered onto scientific data workflows. The software you build here decides how labs around the world adopt that wave.

**Role Summary:**
The DLX platform is a cloud-native, event-driven system of microservices that moves scientific data between instruments, lab applications, and enterprise systems, and increasingly runs AI agents over that data. It has a web UI, but most of the engineering is not web work: it is data processing, orchestration, integration, and backend connectivity in a distributed system. As a Platform Engineer you own features across that whole surface. One week that is a new orchestration capability in a NestJS service talking gRPC and Kafka; the next it is the React screens that expose it; the next it is an agent that acts on the data. You are a generalist by design, and you may bring a specialty on top of that.

**How Engineering Works Here:**
We are a small team with a large product. That shapes everything: You deliver features, not tickets. You get a goal and the context behind it. You work out the plan, the design, the tests, and the rollout. Nobody hands you a task list. AI is part of the job. We use agentic coding tools every day to design, generate, test, and document. You are expected to work this way and to be a sharp reviewer of what the tools produce. You own the result, not the tool. We are regulated. Our customers run validated GxP environments. Data integrity, traceability, and auditability are design constraints, not a checklist at the end. Thinkers and doers. The people who do well here notice problems, propose fixes, get them wrong sometimes, and get them right the next time. They bring ideas back to the team instead of waiting to be told.

**Key Outcomes (First 6 to 12 Months):**
Ship complete features into production: service, contract, data model, UI where needed, tests, documentation. Take a feature from a one-paragraph goal to a working plan and design without waiting for a task breakdown. Raise the quality of the services you touch: contracts, observability, test coverage, performance. Build or extend AI agent capabilities on the platform. Contribute to how the team uses agentic tooling: prompts, skills, review practices, automation. Senior / Lead: own the design of a platform capability end to end and set the bar for the engineers around you.

**Responsibilities:**
Responsibilities Design and build platform features across NestJS/Node.js microservices, gRPC contracts, Kafka event flows, MongoDB data models, and React UI. Build and integrate AI and agentic capabilities into the platform. Write code that meets the platform's data integrity and validation requirements. Use agentic development tools as the default way of working, and review their output critically. Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies as a contributor, not an attendee. Troubleshoot production and integration issues across service boundaries. Senior / Lead: lead technical spikes and architecture decisions; mentor and raise engineering standards.

**Must-Have:**
Strong TypeScript/Node.js and working React. You have built something beyond request/response web APIs: event-driven services, message queues, background processing, distributed data flows. If all you have shipped is Express CRUD, this role will be a hard adjustment. Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, and the judgement to know when they are wrong. A track record of delivering features you were given as goals, not as task lists. Solid engineering fundamentals: design, testing, debugging, reading unfamiliar code. Git and CI/CD in a team setting.

**Good-to-Have:**
Our stack specifically: NestJS, gRPC, CQRS, Kafka, MongoDB, Keycloak, AWS. This is a large plus. Building AI agents, working with MCP servers, or integrating LLMs into products. Regulated software: GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity. Lab informatics or scientific software: LIMS, ELN, CDS, instrument data. Docker, Kubernetes, cloud-native operations.

**Success Indicators:**
Features reach production without needing the plan written for you. The services you touch are better than you found them. Your use of AI tooling makes you faster and your work more thorough, and your peers pick up what you learn. Colleagues in product, quality, and the connectors team trust your judgement. Senior / Lead: platform decisions get made well when the architect is not in the room.

**Why Join Scitara?**
Build the system that moves scientific data for the labs developing the next generation of therapies. Work in an engineering culture where AI-native development is the default, not an experiment. Real ownership: features, designs, and decisions are yours. Clear paths into technical leadership and architecture. A global team of engineers, scientists, and customers.

title: Principal Engineer - Trading Platform
description:
**Job Summary**
Our trading platform is the engine the fund runs on. We're looking for the engineer who will own it — the architecture, the code, and the team that builds it.
  
  
You will set the technical direction and make the hard architectural calls, and you will stay deep in the code, building the most critical and latency-sensitive parts yourself. You will lead a strong engineering team, and you will be accountable for everything the platform does in live markets: that it's fast from tick to trade, that it's correct, that it stays up while markets are open, and that it behaves safely with real capital.
  
  
This is a builder's leadership role. You own the outcomes across the whole platform — including its connectivity, colocation, resilience, security, and regulatory posture — and you will shape the infrastructure and the exchange, broker, and vendor relationships beneath it. What this is not is an IT-administration job: as we grow, dedicated infrastructure and operations support will carry the hands-on run-work so you stay focused on building and leading.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* The architecture and technical direction of the platform end to end — market data, signal, execution, and risk — and the calls that shape how it's built.
* The hardest code. You design and build the critical, latency-sensitive components yourself, and set the engineering standard the team builds to.
* The tick-to-trade path: finding and winning back latency across ingestion, decision, and order placement, and keeping it predictable under load.
* Risk and safety in the system — the pre-trade and at-trade controls that keep the platform from doing damage with real money. These are the controls that have to hold even when everything else is failing.
* Own the testing and staged-rollout discipline that makes changes safe to ship.
* The team — hiring, mentoring senior engineers, owning delivery, and raising the bar.
* Reliability in live markets: uptime through the session, fault tolerance that fails safe, monitoring of both the systems and what they produce (fills, PnL, slippage), incident response during market hours, and the hardening that follows.
* The platform's connection to the outside world — exchange and market-data feeds, the OMS, brokers — and accountability for the leased lines, colocation, physical infrastructure, redundancy, and failover beneath it, including getting new venues (NSE, BSE, MCX) certified and connected and coordinating the exchanges, brokers, and vendors behind them.
* Resilience and continuity — backup connectivity, disaster recovery, and business-continuity planning, tested with real drills.
* Security and governance — setting the security and governance policies, building access control, secrets, and auditability in, and keeping the platform ready for SEBI and exchange scrutiny.
* Scale — growing the platform with data, accounts, strategies, new markets, and AUM, and partnering with research and operations to turn what they need into systems that hold up.

**What Success Looks Like In The First Year**

* You know the platform cold, and the team ships through you without you being the bottleneck.
* Tick-to-trade latency and uptime are measured, understood, and trending the right way.
* The risk controls are something you'd trust with the firm's capital — because you've tested them.
* A new venue or market has gone live cleanly, or the path to it is genuinely de-risked.
* The platform's security and DR posture would survive a SEBI or exchange inspection without a scramble.

**Who You Are**

* A senior engineer who leads from the front — you want to own both the architecture and a team, and you're better at each because you do both.
* Someone who can personally solve the hardest problems in a real-time system, not route them to someone else.
* An owner by temperament — of decisions, of uptime during market hours when something breaks, and of the consequences.
* Calm under the particular pressure of live markets, where mistakes cost money and the clock doesn't stop.
* A clear communicator who can work across research, operations, and compliance, and hold their own with exchanges, brokers, and vendors.

**Required**

* 10+ years building and operating production backend systems, with real time spent leading engineers or owning a platform's technical direction.
* Expert Python and deep command of asyncio and concurrency — event loops, backpressure, race conditions — on an async-end-to-end platform (FastAPI/Starlette, heavy asyncio).
* A real track record with real-time, event-driven systems: live market-data and order-event streams over WebSockets, coordinated through a pub/sub backbone.
* Experience integrating with external trading infrastructure — exchange and market-data feeds, an OMS, and brokers — over socket and HTTP APIs, with the discipline order placement and state tracking demand.
* Strong judgement across a mixed data layer: an operational store such as MongoDB, Redis (with Sentinel for high availability), and a time-series or columnar store such as ClickHouse.
* Proven ability to design always-on services for reliability and observability, and to own uptime in production.
* Comfort owning a containerised, multi-service setup end to end — Docker, CI/CD, and automated deployment.
* Enough grounding in the Indian market-structure and regulatory context — exchange connectivity and colocation, OMSs such as XTS, Greeksoft, or ODIN, venues such as NSE, BSE, and MCX, and SEBI's IT, cyber, DR, and BCP expectations — to own these outcomes and work credibly with exchanges, brokers, and vendors.
* A record of making sound architectural decisions and leading a team to deliver against them.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building high-frequency or ultra-low-latency trading systems, where the hot path is measured in microseconds.
* Hands-on with kernel-bypass networking (Solarflare/Onload, DPDK), FPGA, or other hardware acceleration for market data and order entry.
* Experience with tick-by-tick (TBT) feeds and the colocation setups that make microsecond latency achievable.
* Low-level performance engineering: lock-free data structures, cache-aware and zero-allocation hot paths, and C/C++/Rust where Python can't go.

**Why Northstar**

* Full ownership of the platform the fund runs on, and the mandate to shape where it goes — new venues and markets, an in-house OMS and data-feed adapter, and the move toward lower-latency trading.
* A serious team and direct access to the people running the fund — short path from decision to shipped.
* Meaningful ownership in what you build.
* Health insurance for spouse and kids, a good working environment, and an annual company retreat.

**Job Title**

* Engagement type Application maintenance and support (AMS) / managed services.
* Clients Pharma, biotech and life sciences sponsors, including big pharma.

 

**Role overview**

i2e Consulting is hiring a Analyst to support Veeva Vault CTMS in production for our pharma, biotech and life sciences clients. You will be the functional owner of the system after go-live across six areas: production support, Veeva administration, release management, enhancements and change requests, integration and data support, and adoption, compliance and continuous improvement.

You will work directly with client Clinical Operations teams, Veeva, and our delivery team to keep the system stable, validated under GxP and 21 CFR Part 11, and improving with each release. This is a fully remote role, and we need someone who can join immediately and pick up live client support from day one.

 

**Key responsibilities**

1. Production support

• Manage L1/L2/L3 incidents and service requests for Veeva Vault CTMS within agreed SLAs.

• Troubleshoot user issues across studies, sites, monitoring visits, milestones and issue management.

• Investigate and resolve workflow failures, stuck tasks and access or permission issues.

• Perform root-cause analysis on repeat incidents and drive permanent fixes.

• Escalate product defects to Veeva Support and manage vendor escalations through to closure.

• Report ticket volumes, SLA performance and top issues to client stakeholders.

2. Veeva administration

• Manage users, roles, security profiles, permission sets and sharing settings in line with access SOPs.

• Maintain security configuration and support periodic user access reviews.

• Configure and maintain workflows, object and document lifecycles, document types and metadata.

• Set up and maintain notifications, picklists, page layouts and other routine configuration.

• Maintain CTMS master data such as studies, study countries, sites, milestone templates and monitoring visit templates.

3. Release management

• Review release notes for Veeva's three general releases each year and assess impact on client configuration and processes.

• Complete impact analysis and decide which new features to enable, defer or leave off.

• Test new and changed functionality in the sandbox before production.

• Run and maintain the regression test suite for core CTMS processes.

• Update validation documents and confirm production readiness with client QA and business owners.

• Communicate release changes to users before each go-live.

4. Enhancements and change requests

• Gather and analyse requirements for new workflows, fields, objects, reports and dashboards.

• Write user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications and process flows.

• Assess, estimate and prioritise change requests with client Clinical Operations.

• Configure or coordinate configuration changes, then test and deploy them through change control.

• Keep the enhancement backlog aligned with evolving business requirements.

5. Integration and data support

• Monitor integrations between CTMS and connected systems such as eTMF, EDC, IRT and data warehouses.

• Investigate failed interfaces and jobs, identify root causes and coordinate fixes.

• Troubleshoot API and integration issues with technical and vendor teams.

• Resolve data issues, run data reconciliation and perform data corrections through approved processes.

• Keep master data aligned across CTMS and connected systems.

6. Adoption, compliance and continuous improvement

• Deliver user training, onboarding and refresher sessions for CRAs, study managers and other CTMS users.

• Update SOPs, work instructions and process documentation as the system changes.

• Write and maintain knowledge articles and FAQs for users and the support team.

• Keep the system in a validated state under GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and GAMP 5 through change control, periodic reviews and audit-trail reviews.

• Support client QA during audits and regulatory inspections.

• Monitor system adoption and usage, and recommend process and configuration improvements.

**Required qualifications**

• Degree in life sciences, pharmacy, IT or a related field.

• 3–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst on Veeva Vault CTMS.

• Hands-on experience supporting Veeva Vault CTMS in production after go-live, in an AMS or managed services setup.

• Prior experience supporting a big pharma client.

• Good understanding of clinical trial operations and ICH-GCP (E6).

• Available to join immediately and work remotely.

**Must-have skills**

• Veeva Vault CTMS functional knowledge: studies, study countries, sites, monitoring visits and trip reports, milestones, issue and protocol deviation management, enrollment tracking and trial oversight.

• Veeva Vault administration: users, roles, security profiles, permission sets, workflows, lifecycles, document types, metadata, notifications, reports and dashboards.

• Production support: L1/L2/L3 incident, problem and request management against SLAs, using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management.

• Release management and testing: release impact analysis, sandbox and regression testing, test script writing and execution, defect management and UAT coordination.

• Validation (CSV): change control, URS/FRS/RTM updates and periodic review under GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and GAMP 5, with sound Good Documentation Practice.

• Integration and data: monitoring interfaces and jobs, data reconciliation and basic API troubleshooting.

• Requirements and documentation: user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and knowledge articles.

• Stakeholder management: confident client-facing communication, training delivery and workshop facilitation.

• Ways of working: experience in Agile/Scrum teams; strong planning, organisation and follow-through on commitments.

**Good to have**

• Exposure to the wider Veeva Clinical suite (eTMF, Study Start-Up, Site Connect, Site Payments).

• Experience with Vault Loader, data loads or Vault API.

• Experience migrating from a legacy CTMS such as Siebel.

• ITIL Foundation or a similar service management certification.

• Experience supporting regulatory inspections or client audits of a CTMS.

* Implement monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting to maintain production reliability.
* Investigate incidents, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Evaluate performance, scalability, security, resource utilization, and cost efficiency.
* Establish safe deployment practices, rollback mechanisms, and operational runbooks.
* Measure the impact of deployed solutions through meaningful technical and business outcomes.

**6. Product Feedback & Reusable Engineering**

* Collaborate with Host360’s Platform Engineering, Product, and AI Infrastructure teams to address challenges encountered during customer deployments.
* Convert recurring customer requirements into reusable tools, platform capabilities, and product improvements.
* Document architecture decisions, deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides, and implementation patterns.
* Develop reusable reference architectures, automation scripts, and technical playbooks.
* Share real-world feedback to improve Host360’s cloud platform, AI infrastructure, and developer experience.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong engineering mindset with the ability to independently investigate problems, design solutions, write code, and deliver working systems.
* 2-4 years of hands-on experience in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical role.
* Strong programming experience in Python, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, or another relevant language, with the ability to build practical engineering tools and integrations.
* Hands-on experience designing, deploying, or operating cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, GCP, private cloud, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience working with Linux systems, networking fundamentals, APIs, distributed systems, and production troubleshooting.
* Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, containerized applications, or cloud-native deployment environments.
* Experience with infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, or Infrastructure as Code.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into technical architectures and working implementations.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across application, infrastructure, and platform layers.
* Ability to take ownership of a problem from discovery and implementation through deployment, troubleshooting, and optimization.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with customer engineers and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying or supporting AI, Generative AI, LLM, or machine learning workloads in production.
* Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA fundamentals, GPU scheduling, or GPU resource utilization.
* Experience with model serving and inference frameworks such as vLLM, NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with open-source AI models, model runtimes, inference optimization, and AI application frameworks.
* Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Helm, GitOps, or Kubernetes operators.
* Exposure to private cloud and virtualization technologies such as OpenStack, VMware, Nutanix, or Proxmox.
* Experience with observability platforms, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or distributed tracing.
* Familiarity with databases, object storage, data pipelines, and enterprise application integration.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to build, debug, test, and maintain production software.
* Previous experience in customer engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or embedded engineering roles.

**What We’re Looking For**

We value demonstrated engineering ability, practical problem-solving, and ownership over a particular combination of degrees, certifications, or technology keywords.

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Enjoy getting hands-on with unfamiliar systems and figuring out how they work.
* Can move from an unclear customer problem to a working implementation without relying entirely on predefined instructions.
* Are comfortable switching between application code, cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, and AI workloads.
* Prefer building and debugging real systems over producing architecture documents alone.
* Can explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
* Take responsibility for production outcomes rather than considering a deployment complete when the initial setup is finished.
* Enjoy learning new technologies and sharing what you learn with the wider engineering team.

**At Host360, we are looking for engineers who don’t just recommend solutions — they build them, deploy them, and make them work in production.**

title: Senior Technology Solutions Specialist (OGC)
description:
**Description**
**About the Role**
The oil, gas and chemical sector is undergoing a profound and accelerating transformation. To maintain a competitive edge in an increasingly dynamic market, our organization is embracing digitalization and automation to enhance operational efficiency, improve safety standards, and drive long-term sustainability goals. This role is not merely about writing code or managing systems — it is about fundamentally reshaping how we operate. You will stand at the forefront of this transformation, harnessing cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges: from optimizing production workflows and predicting maintenance needs, to ensuring the security and resilience of our critical infrastructure.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated, innovative, and results-driven Senior Technology Solution Specialist to join our technology team. In this pivotal role, you will design, develop, and deploy software solutions that power our digital initiatives — playing a crucial part in building, implementing, and maintaining technologies that elevate our engineering processes to new heights.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Software Development & Solution Architecture
* Design, develop, and deploy scalable full-stack software applications supporting digital transformation initiatives across the oil, gas and chemical value chain.
* Lead end-to-end solution design from requirements gathering through architecture, development, testing, and production deployment.
* Build robust APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python and modern development frameworks.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and frameworks to improve solution quality and delivery speed.

* Develop and manage data solutions on Microsoft Databricks and Data verse, including data ingestion, transformation, modelling, and analytics workflows.
* Build and maintain data pipelines that enable real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance models, and production optimization dashboards.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and security across all digital platforms and data assets.
* Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to productionize machine learning models and analytical tools.
* Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
* Design, deploy, and manage cloud-based solutions on Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), following best practices for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and DevOps practices to accelerate delivery.
* Monitor system health, performance, and security; proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure operational continuity.
* Manage infrastructure-as-code, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud-native architectures.
* Collaboration Platforms & Knowledge Management
* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft SharePoint solutions for document management, team collaboration, and internal portals.
* Develop automation workflows and integrations between SharePoint, Teams, and other enterprise systems to streamline operations.
* Champion digital workspace best practices and drive user adoption of collaboration tools across the organization.
* Agile Delivery & Project Management
* Act as Scrum Master for agile delivery teams, facilitating sprint ceremonies, managing backlogs, and removing impediments to ensure consistent delivery.
* Manage project workflows using Jira and Confluence — maintaining transparency, tracking progress, and providing stakeholder reporting.
* Mentor team members on agile methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and iterative delivery.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders including engineers, operations, HSE, and business leaders to align technology solutions with organizational objectives.
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement
* Proactively identify opportunities to apply digital technologies — including IoT, AI/ML, automation, and advanced analytics — to enhance safety, efficiency, and sustainability.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and technology pilots, translating business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory requirements relevant to the oil, gas and chemical sector.

**Required Technical Skills**

* The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in Full Stack Development, Python, Microsoft Databricks & Data verse, Azure Deployment, GCP & DevOps, Microsoft SharePoint, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira & Confluence, and CI/CD Pipelines.
* Full Stack Development
* Proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Strong back-end development experience with RESTful APIs, Node.js, .NET, or similar server-side technologies.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB).
* Python
* Advanced Python programming skills for application development, data engineering, automation, and scripting.
* Experience with Python libraries for data processing and analytics (Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, SQLAlchemy).
* Microsoft Databricks & Data verse
* Hands-on experience building and managing Databricks workspaces, Delta Lake, and Spark-based data pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Data verse for data modelling, integration, and Power Platform solutions.
* Azure Deployment
* Proven ability to architect, deploy, and manage cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure (App Services, ADF, Azure Functions, AKS, Azure DevOps).
* Experience with Azure security, identity management (AAD), networking, and monitoring tools.
* GCP & DevOps
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform services (BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub).
* Strong DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and version control with Git.
* Microsoft SharePoint
* Experience designing and configuring SharePoint Online sites, libraries, lists, and workflows.
* Ability to develop custom SharePoint solutions and Power Automate integrations.
* Agile Project Management — Scrum Master
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM or equivalent) with practical experience leading agile ceremonies in cross-functional teams.
* Proficient in Jira for sprint management, backlog grooming, and reporting; Confluence for documentation and knowledge management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6 to 10 years of progressive experience in software development and IT, with demonstrated leadership on complex technology projects.
* Experience within the oil, gas, chemical, or broader energy and industrial sectors is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT convergence, industrial IoT, and digital twin concepts is a plus.
* Relevant certifications (Azure, GCP, Databricks, Scrum Master) are advantageous.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
* A self-starter with strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, and a passion for technology-driven innovation.

**What We Offer**

* A high-impact role at the center of the digital transformation of a critical global industry.
* Opportunity to work with advanced technology stacks across cloud, data, and automation domains.
* Collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.

**Why Join Us**

* This role places you at the intersection of engineering and technology on real projects that affect safety, schedules and long term assets. You will work with colleagues across India and the United States, see how design decisions turn into built facilities and shape tools that help people do some of the most complex work in our industry.
* Burns & McDonnell is an employee owned company, and many people build entire careers here because of the stability, long term horizon and shared ownership culture. Day to day work planning will be coordinated with the Technology and Innovation Manager, with input from Engineering leadership on priority workflows and pilots.

* This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into a technology leader within our organization. In the first year, you will focus on mastering our existing systems and delivering key software projects. Following that, you will have the opportunity to lead new initiatives, mentor junior team members and specialize in areas such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity or enterprise architecture. We are committed to your professional development and will provide you with the resources and support needed to stay at the forefront of technology and advance your career.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Site Reliability Engineer (GCP / GKE) – Payments Platform**

**Location:**
[City] |
**Work mode:**
[Onsite / Hybrid] |
**Experience:**
3+ years |
**Employment type:**
Full-time

**About the opportunity**

Our client is building a payments platform that has to stay up and secure while it scales to 50 million transactions a day. The systems team runs the cloud foundation underneath it: GCP, Kubernetes, networking, security and monitoring.

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will own that infrastructure from start to finish. That means designing and building it right the first time, then keeping it reliable in production. You’ll work closely with network providers, banking partners, vendor support teams and internal project teams.

**Key responsibilities**

*Cloud infrastructure*

* Set up and build out a Google Cloud (GCP) Landing Zone
* Make infrastructure changes through Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and automation scripts
* Keep environments consistent, version-controlled and audit-ready

*Kubernetes (GKE)*

* Design, set up and configure GKE clusters for production workloads
* Handle scaling, capacity planning and troubleshooting of cluster and application errors
* Keep clusters healthy, patched and optimised

*Networking*

* Design and implement VPCs, peering, segmentation, load balancers and Cloud Interconnect
* Find and fix connectivity issues
* Triage incidents together with network teams, interconnect providers and banking partners

*Security and monitoring*

* Implement monitoring, logging and alerting using Cloud Monitoring/Logging (Stackdriver) and Security Command Center
* Track access, uptime and failures, and apply security best practices
* Build dashboards and alerts that catch problems before customers notice them

*Third-party tools*

* Implement and manage enterprise next-gen firewalls (Check Point): rules, alerts and timely upgrades
* Set up and configure Redis Enterprise
* Manage Envoy Proxy configuration using Ansible
* Work with vendor support teams to resolve issues and roll out changes

*Incident management and operations*

* Respond to and resolve critical incidents, including outages affecting many users
* Keep customers updated proactively under SLA-based engagements
* Write root-cause analyses (RCAs) and put permanent fixes in place

**What we’re looking for**

*Must have*

* 3+ years of hands-on experience in SRE, DevOps or cloud infrastructure, covering both building and running production systems
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes (GKE preferred) in production
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
* Solid networking fundamentals: VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancing, firewalls and DNS
* Experience with monitoring, logging and alerting tools
* Scripting in Bash or Python, or both
* Real on-call and incident-handling experience in production

*Good to have*

* Google Cloud experience, especially Landing Zone setup and Cloud Interconnect
* Check Point or another enterprise firewall (Palo Alto, Fortinet)
* Redis or Redis Enterprise setup and configuration
* Envoy Proxy, and Ansible for configuration management
* Experience in payments, banking, fintech or another high-transaction environment
* Exposure to chaos engineering

*Certifications (preferred, not mandatory)*

* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) / Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Cloud Network Engineer
* HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate

**Work schedule – please read**

* This is a production support role with rotational shifts and variable week-offs
* You need to be available for incidents outside working hours
* Support may be needed on national and local holidays, based on business needs
* You should be comfortable working calmly under pressure during critical incidents

**Why join**

* **Scale:**
  build systems for India-scale payments, with a target of 50 million transactions a day
* **Learn from first principles:**
  an internal “school” for distributed systems that speeds up how fast you learn
* **Production is your playground:**
  use modern chaos engineering to break systems on purpose, find weak points and make them resilient
* **Ownership:**
  you design it, run it and improve it, not just maintain someone else’s setup
* **Team culture:**
  work with people who want to understand how things really work

**Who will thrive here**

* System builders who think from first principles
* Chaos engineers who’d rather bring a system down on purpose than have it fail by surprise
* Responsible SREs who want to be confident that what they build stays up

title: Principal Support Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
**Escalations & Customer Experience Engineering**
The Principal Support Engineer is a senior, hands-on technical expert responsible for driving rapid resolution of complex customer issues. This role blends deep technical troubleshooting, advanced log and API analysis, Datadog monitoring expertise, and leadership of high‑severity escalations. The engineer will collaborate tightly with Engineering, Product, and external vendors to eliminate root causes, improve MTTR, and elevate the overall customer experience.
  
  
This is a high‑visibility individual contributor role requiring strong ownership, urgency, and the ability to translate complex technical problems into clear, actionable paths forward for both customers and internal stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform hands‑on technical troubleshooting using Datadog (logs, traces, dashboards), API tools (Postman/cURL), and distributed log tracing.
* Lead high-severity and strategic customer escalations, providing authoritative technical direction and timely communication.
* Drive vendor ticket escalations, ensuring SLA adherence and proactive follow‑ups with Microsoft, Adobe, AWS, Cisco, and others.
* Collaborate with Engineering to deliver root-cause fixes, submit detailed technical findings, and validate permanent resolutions.
* Partner with Product to identify platform gaps, recurring customer pain points, and areas for workflow or UX improvement.
* Analyze MTTR performance, SLA trends, and operational bottlenecks; publish weekly metrics and insights.
* Develop SOPs, escalation workflows, and troubleshooting guides that improve global support operations.
* Identify automation opportunities and collaborate with internal teams to enhance Zendesk workflows and self-service deflection.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 10+ years in Technical Support Engineering, Escalations, SRE, or related roles.
* Expertise with Datadog (log search, traces, monitors, dashboards).
* Strong REST API troubleshooting using Postman, cURL, authentication flows, and JSON payload analysis.
* Experience diagnosing distributed systems, integrations, and SaaS platform behavior.
* Proven ability to interface with strategic enterprise customers and communicate complex technical issues clearly.
* Hands‑on experience with vendor escalation processes and SLA governance.
* Strong working knowledge of MTTR, incident management, and technical support KPIs.
* Familiarity with Zendesk or similar ticketing platforms.

**Performance Expectations & KPIs**

* Resolve ≥90% of escalated tickets within SLA.
* Engage vendors within 15 minutes of SLA risk detection.
* Drive MTTR improvements of 40–50% for assigned ticket categories.
* Maintain CSAT ≥90% for escalated interactions.
* Identify and support permanent fixes for at least 2 recurring root-cause issues per quarter.
* Deliver 3–5 workflow, automation, or SOP improvements each quarter.
* This is not a complete listing of the job duties. It’s a representation of the things you will be doing, and you may not perform all of these duties.
