title: Senior Technical Account Manager (L3)
description:
**Department:**
Sales
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Permanent - Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai, India
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for an On-Site Technical Account Manager (L3) to act as a dedicated Resident Engineer for a major enterprise deployment. Working directly at the customer site, you will serve as the primary technical bridge between local operations, internal engineering teams, and vendor support to ensure high availability and rapid issue resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Investigate and resolve escalated Hazelcast component issues. Lead root-cause analysis for P1, recurring and critical incidents with Hazelcast support, keep stakeholders informed and track permanent corrective actions through closure. When an incident closes, make sure the knowledge base captures the cause, permanent fix and lessons learned.
* Coordinate Hazelcast support cases for product bugs, patches and escalations; promptly notify RBI of critical defects or security vulnerabilities and track remediation and closure status.
* Recommend, configure and validate RBI-approved Hazelcast designs for high availability, resilience, throughput and scalability in line with Hazelcast guidance, working with L2 and developers on complex workflow, connector, integration and performance issues.
* Plan and carry out approved UAT, pre-production and production updates with impact and risk analysis, approved operating procedures, test and rollback plans, execution in approved maintenance windows and post-change validation.
* Advise RBI security teams on Hazelcast hardening; assess releases and patches and maintain upgrade, adoption and infrastructure-lifecycle roadmap recommendations.
* Work with RBI’s performance-monitoring team to establish baselines, diagnose bottlenecks and implement tuning and configuration improvements with measurable before-and-after results.
* Perform capacity planning and sizing and conduct periodic capacity and utilization reviews, including annual audits and corrective recommendations for threshold breaches.
* Maintain senior-level operating procedures and technical documentation; guide L1/L2 teams through knowledge sharing, current industry trends, best practices and thoughtful automation.
* Provide senior oversight for complex or escalated service requests, authorizations, coordination issues and configuration-backup concerns, while the L2 TAM owns routine handling. Help keep the agreed roles and responsibilities (RACI) and escalation matrix current, join remote, OEM and on-call coverage, and contribute to quarterly service-level reporting and RBI certification. The team supports unlimited cases, with response targets of 30 minutes initially and 1 hour ongoing for P1; 1 hour and 2 hours for P2; 4 hours and 8 business hours for P3; and 8 hours and 2 working days for all other cases.

**What You Have**

* Graduate qualification such as BE, BSc, MCA or equivalent; an engineering background is preferred.
* At least 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years designing, implementing and upgrading Hazelcast or the directly relevant OEM product.
* Advanced Hazelcast architecture, configuration, high-availability, resilience and distributed-caching expertise, including security hardening and lifecycle management across UAT, pre-production and production.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex production incidents, P1 root-cause analysis, permanent corrective actions and OEM engineering/support escalations.
* Strong performance-tuning, capacity-planning, sizing, throughput and scalability skills supported by measurable validation.
* Ability to work with RBI stakeholders, developers and L1/L2 teams; communicate recommendations and approved decisions clearly and produce strong operating procedures, configuration records, root-cause analysis reports, roadmaps and knowledge-transfer guidance.
* Be prepared to share degree records, project dates, relevant experience and evidence of your Hazelcast or OEM association so Hazelcast can support RBI’s approval process.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Business Area:**
Professional Services
  
  
**Seniority Level:**
Mid-Senior level
  
  
**Job Description:**
At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.
  
  
Cloudera is seeking a
**Solutions Architect**
to join its APAC Professional Services team. In this role you’ll have the opportunity to develop massively scalable solutions to solve complex data problems using Hadoop, NiFi, Spark and related Big Data technology. This role is a client facing opportunity that combines consulting skills with deep technical design and development in the Big Data space. This role will present the successful candidate the opportunity to travel across Asia Pacific and across multiple industries and large customer organisations, This position is based onsite in Mumbai.
  
  
**As the Solutions Architect you will:**

* Work directly with customer business and technical teams to understand requirements and develop high quality solutions
* Design highly scalable and reliable data pipelines to consume, integrate, and analyze large amounts of data from various sources.
* Able to understand big data use-cases and recommend standard design, implementation patterns used in Hadoop-based deployments
* Able to document and present complex architectures for the customer’s technical teams
* Work closely with Cloudera teams at all levels to ensure project and customer success
* Design effective data models for optimal storage and retrieval, deploy inclusive data quality checks to ensure high quality of data
* Design, build, tune and maintain data pipelines using Hadoop, NiFi or related data integration technologies
* Install, deploy, augment, upgrade, manage and operate large Hadoop clusters
* Write and produce technical documentation, customer status reports and knowledge-base articles
* Keep up with current Hadoop, NiFi, Big Data ecosystem / technologies.

**We’re excited about you if you have:**

* Overall 12+ years IT experience, with at least 4+ years of production experience working with Hadoop and/or NiFi, data engineering.
* Hands-on experience with all aspects of developing, testing and implementing low-latency big data pipelines.
* Demonstrated production experience in data engineering, data management, cluster management and/or analytics domains.
* Experience designing data queries against data in the HDFS environment using tools such as Apache Hive
* Experience implementing MapReduce, Spark jobs
* Experience setting up multi-node Hadoop clusters
* Experience in systems administration or DevOps experience with one or more open-source operating systems [Big Data Developers interested in Administration and consulting can also apply]
* Experience with Data Warehouse design, ETL (Extraction, Transformation & Load), architecting efficient software designs for DW platform.
* Experience implementing operational best practices such as alerting, monitoring, and metadata management.
* Strong understanding with various enterprise security practices and solutions such as LDAP and/or Kerberos
* Experience using configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet or Chef
* Familiarity with scripting tools such as bash shell scripts, Python and/or Perl
* Experience with Apache NiFi is desired
* Significant previous work writing to network-based APIs, preferably REST/JSON or XML/SOAP
* Understanding of the Java ecosystem and enterprise offerings, including debugging and profiling tools (e.g. jstack, jmap, jconsole), logging and monitoring tools (log4j, JMX)
* Ability to understand and translate customer requirements into technical requirements
* Excellent verbal and written communications

**You may also have:**

title: Data Engineering Manager - Enterprise Data Platform
description:
**Data Engineering Manager - Enterprise Data Platform**

**Job Overview**

As a Data Engineering Manager within the Enterprise Data Platform team at Client team, you will lead a team of skilled data engineers responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines, managing large-scale data models, and ensuring the quality, availability, and performance of enterprise data assets. This leadership role combines technical depth,strategic thinking, and people management to enable Client team’s data-driven decision-making and analytics capabilities.

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across Technology & Engineering, Product, Sales, Marketing, Research, Finance, and Administration to deliver robust, scalable data solutions. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a strong background in modern data platforms, cloud architecture, and team development—someone passionate about empowering teams and improving data capabilities across the organization. A core part of this role is shaping an analytics environment that is built for AI agents as much as for people. Our analysts, executives and AI agents should all query the same governed, documented, well-described data and get the same answers. You will lead the team to make that real, with semantic layers, governed metrics, rich metadata, agent- safe access, and evaluation of agent output, and in using agents to build faster and with higher quality.

This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership role: you will guide architectural decisions, mentor engineers, collaborate with cross-functional leaders, and contribute to building next-generation data and AI capabilities at client teams. You will exhibit a growth mindset, be willing to solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, and help create a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose. If you love leading a team of passionate data engineers, building data-centric solutions, strive for excellence every day, are adaptable and focused, and believe work should be fun, come join us!

**Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, retain top talent and develop a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Define and drive the data engineering roadmap aligned with enterprise data strategy and business objectives
* Collaborate with senior technology and business leaders to define data platform priorities, architecture, and long-term vision
* Promote a culture of innovation, operational rigor, and customer empathy within the data organization
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of high-quality data pipelines and ELT/ETL workflows across enterprise systems and Client Team’s platform
* Ensure scalable, secure, and reliable data architectures using modern cloud technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Airflow, Kafka, Docker)
* Lead AI learning initiatives and integrate AI/ML-driven solutions into data products to enhance automation, predictive insights, and decision intelligence
* Champion data quality, governance, lineage, and compliance standards across the enterprise data ecosystem
* Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to optimize data storage, compute performance, and cost efficiency
* Support career development through mentoring, skill-building, and performance feedback

**Experience, Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles, including at least 2–3 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
* Proven experience designing and maintaining large-scale data architectures, pipelines, and data models in cloud environments (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python for data manipulation, transformation, and automation
* Deep understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), and distributed messaging systems (e.g., Kafka)
* Strong knowledge of data governance, quality, and compliance frameworks
* Experience working with enterprise data sources (CRM, ERP, Marketing Automation, Financial Systems, etc.) is preferred
* Hands-on experience with AI/ML platforms, model deployment, or data-driven automation is a strong plus
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complex data concepts into business value
* Demonstrated ability to build high-performing teams and lead through change

**Must have skills :**

* **Airflow**
* **Kafka**
* **Snowflake**
* **Python**
* **SQL**

and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s 

AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. 

 

As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

 

**The Role**

The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.

 

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

 

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

 

**What You’ll Do**

  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
  1. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  2. Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  3. Embedding generation and optimization
  4. Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  1. Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  2. Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  1. Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  2. Relevance and precision/recall
  3. Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  4. Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8–12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: MS-FDL-Senior Manager-Platform Engineering Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Manager – Platform Engineering**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – Platform Engineering to lead the strategy, engineering, and operations of a scalable enterprise platform supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines platform architecture, engineering execution, and people leadership, with accountability for secure, reliable, and cost-efficient shared capabilities. The ideal candidate will enable application and data engineering teams through self-service infrastructure, standardized delivery workflows, and a strong developer experience, supporting finance transformation solutions across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will own the platform engineering roadmap, delivery governance, and team development, partnering with product, architecture, security, and business leaders to improve engineering productivity and deliver measurable business outcomes across client engagements.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Technology & Architecture Leadership**

* Own the platform engineering strategy and architecture roadmap, aligning cloud infrastructure, shared services, and modernization priorities with business and product goals.
* Lead the design and evolution of secure, resilient cloud-native platforms, including container orchestration, networking, identity, secrets management, and standardized environments.
* Establish engineering standards, reference architectures, infrastructure-as-code patterns, and automated guardrails for consistent provisioning and operation of platform services.
* Enable application, data, and AI/ML workloads through reusable platform capabilities, APIs, integration patterns, and scalable compute and storage services.
* Own CI/CD and release engineering capabilities, including automated testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment strategies, and rollback readiness.
* Provide technical leadership for critical incidents, architectural reviews, and complex engineering decisions; drive root-cause analysis and durable corrective actions.

**Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Lead delivery planning and governance across platform workstreams, managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and commitments against agreed business outcomes.
* Embed agile, DevOps, and SRE practices, including service ownership, observability, on-call readiness, incident response, and tested disaster recovery.
* Define and track service-level indicators and objectives, agreed SLAs, and engineering delivery metrics to improve reliability, deployment performance, and recovery times.
* Drive capacity planning, performance optimization, and FinOps practices; manage platform budgets and vendors to improve cost efficiency without compromising reliability.
* Partner with security and governance teams to embed access controls, vulnerability remediation, auditability, data protection, and compliance requirements into platform operations.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale multidisciplinary platform engineering teams spanning cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, and automation; develop engineering managers and technical leads.
* Build a high-performance, inclusive engineering culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.
* Own workforce planning, hiring, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with the platform roadmap.
* Coach managers and engineers on technical judgment, execution discipline, stakeholder engagement, and career growth; delegate effectively while maintaining accountability.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with product teams, enterprise architects, security leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, and clients to translate business needs into platform priorities.
* Balance platform investment, delivery capacity, risk, and business value; align stakeholders on trade-offs, service expectations, and measurable outcomes.
* Support solutioning, proposals, and client discussions with platform architecture, delivery estimates, operating models, and cost considerations.
* Communicate roadmap progress, investment needs, service health, delivery risks, and business impact clearly to executive stakeholders.

**Platform & Product Mindset**

* Manage the platform as an internal product, using developer feedback and adoption metrics to prioritize capabilities that reduce friction and accelerate delivery.
* Build self-service workflows, reusable infrastructure modules, service catalogs, and standardized delivery paths with clear documentation and onboarding.
* Measure platform value through adoption, developer satisfaction, onboarding time, delivery lead time, and reduced operational toil; enable secure analytics and AI use cases.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE, including substantial architecture and delivery ownership.
* 5+ years of engineering people-management experience, with a demonstrated track record of leading multiple teams and developing engineering managers or technical leads.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including networking, identity, security, resilience, and cloud operating models.
* Strong expertise in cloud-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform), and automated environment provisioning.
* Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, observability, and automation using relevant tools and languages (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Argo CD, OpenTelemetry, Python, or Go).
* Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and shared platform services; experience enabling data platforms and integration workloads.
* Experience with secure-by-design engineering, identity and access management, secrets management, software supply-chain security, and enterprise governance.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to deliver enterprise platform programs, manage cross-team dependencies, and establish effective execution and risk governance.
* Experience implementing DevOps and SRE practices, including SLOs, error budgets, incident management, post-incident reviews, and disaster recovery testing.
* Strong understanding of scalability, capacity planning, performance tuning, cloud cost optimization, budget ownership, and vendor management.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise data and application needs; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, analytics platforms, or other data-intensive enterprise products is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, organizational planning, and talent development skills, with the ability to lead through managers and technical leads.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and influence across business and technology teams.
* Ability to balance long-term platform strategy with pragmatic delivery, sound technical judgment, and hands-on engagement when needed.
* High ownership mindset focused on platform adoption, developer productivity, reliability, and measurable business outcomes.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

**Position Title:**

**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

**Overview**
As part of our Cyber Security team, you will implement and support Secure SDLC (SSDLC) and DevSecOps practices across the software development lifecycle, ensuring security is embedded into design, development, testing, and deployment stages.
  
  
You will perform hands-on security assessments of applications, APIs, and supporting infrastructure, and work closely with DevOps, Architects, Developers, and QA teams to integrate security into CI/CD pipelines. You will analyze security findings, provide remediation guidance, and contribute to building secure, scalable application delivery practices.

We’re looking for a Senior Consultant – DevSecOps / Application Security with strong hands-on expertise in secure SDLC and pipeline security. This role offers the opportunity to work on end-to-end DevSecOps implementations, supporting clients and engineering teams in embedding security across CI/CD pipelines.

* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and secure coding practices.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and basic cloud security concepts.
* Exposure to container technologies and security tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Understanding of DevSecOps practices and SSDLC frameworks (OWASP SAMM, NIST SSDF).
* Hands-on experience with SCM tools (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) and pipeline integrations.
* Good understanding of threat modeling concepts (e.g., STRIDE).
* Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI tools in development/security workflows (e.g., AI-assisted code analysis, automation).
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams.

* BE/ B.Tech/ MCA.
* Minimum 3 years of work experience
* Certifications: Mandatory to have any one of the below certifications,
* Azure Security Architect (Az-500)
* AWS security speciality certification (SCS-C01)

**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Data Operations & Technical Oversight**

* Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
* Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
* Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
* Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
* Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
* Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

**Service Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
* Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
* Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
* Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
* Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
* Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

**Data Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
* Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
* Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer {Mumbai}
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

description:

For more information, visit www.bdxworld.com

**Role Summary**

The Senior IT Operations Lead will provide technical leadership and operational ownership of the organization's internal IT infrastructure and OT technology environment supporting Data Center operations. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role within a captive Data Center organization, responsible for the reliability, security, availability, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of the organization's own technology environment.

**Please Note: This is 70% hands on technical (Individual Contributor ) and 30% team management role. Candidates with stroing hands on IT Infrastructure and Data Center Operations experience are encouraged to apply. Candidates with predominatly managerial experince need not apply.**

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**1. IT Infrastructure Operations & Reliability**

• Provide technical and operational leadership for the organization's enterprise IT infrastructure supporting corporate and Data Center operations.

• Ensure the availability, reliability, performance, and security of infrastructure operating on a 24x7x365 basis.

• Oversee networking, servers and compute, virtualization, storage, backup, firewalls, security infrastructure, wireless, telephony, collaboration systems, end-user computing, and monitoring platforms.

• Drive proactive monitoring, capacity planning, performance optimization, technology lifecycle management, and operational KPI tracking.

**2. OT Security & Data Center Technology Environment**

• Support and govern IT and OT security procedures relevant to Data Center operations.

• Work closely with Data Center Operations, Engineering, Security, Automation, and Technology teams to ensure appropriate protection and segregation of IT and OT environments.

• Develop and maintain procedures for secure access, privileged access, remote connectivity, patching, vulnerability management, and system hardening.

• Support security assessments, audits, vulnerability remediation, risk mitigation, incident response, and root cause analysis involving IT and OT-related systems.

**3. IT Service Management & Operational Governance**

• Lead and continuously improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, and Asset Management processes.

• Analyse recurring incidents and operational trends and implement preventive and corrective actions.

• Drive service reviews, KPI reporting, risk tracking, root cause analysis, and continual service improvement.

**4. Infrastructure Architecture & Technology Lifecycle**

• Participate in infrastructure reviews and assess the impact of new systems, technology changes, and infrastructure enhancements.

• Provide recommendations for scalability, resilience, security, operational supportability, and risk mitigation.

• Support infrastructure modernization including cloud, hybrid infrastructure, software-defined networking, automation, and Infrastructure-as-a-Service models.

**5. SDLC, Change & Release Governance**

• Demonstrate strong awareness of SDLC and its impact on infrastructure and production environments.

• Work with application, automation, engineering, and technology teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for development, testing, deployment, and production releases.

• Ensure appropriate testing, documentation, rollback plans, approvals, risk assessments, and operational readiness before production implementation.

**6. Information Security, Compliance & Documentation**

• Support compliance with ISO 27001 and ISO 20000 requirements and maintain relevant operational documentation and evidence.

• Maintain infrastructure standards, procedures, architecture diagrams, Configuration Items (CIs), CMDB records, and IT asset documentation.

• Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings and compliance actions.

**7. Security, Monitoring & Critical Incident Management**

• Provide technical oversight for routers, switches, Layer 2/3 networks, firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and connectivity infrastructure.

• Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, operational visibility, and proactive issue detection.

• Lead technical investigations for major incidents, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

**8. Vendor & Internal Stakeholder Management**

• Manage technical relationships and escalations with infrastructure, security, telecommunications, and technology vendors.

• Partner with internal Data Center Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Automation, Applications, Corporate IT, Facilities, and business stakeholders.

• Communicate technical risks, operational performance, improvement initiatives, and infrastructure status to senior stakeholders.

**9. Individual Contributor Technical Leadership**

• Act as a senior technical owner and subject matter expert, leading through technical expertise, governance, influence, and operational ownership.

• Work independently on complex technical and operational issues and mentor engineers where required.

• This is primarily a hands-on senior individual contributor role and is not intended to be a traditional service delivery, customer account management, or managed services role.

**Qualification & Experience**

15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, infrastructure operations, or IT operations leadership.

• Experience supporting business-critical, highly available, 24x7x365 infrastructure environments.

• Strong experience operating internal enterprise or captive technology environments; experience should not be limited to external customer managed services delivery.

• Strong technical experience across enterprise networking, Layer 2/3 infrastructure, routers, switches, firewalls, WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, servers, virtualization, monitoring, infrastructure security, backup, and configuration management.

• Strong experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and continual service improvement.

• Practical understanding of IT and OT security principles, access management, vulnerability remediation, patching, infrastructure hardening, and operational security procedures.

• Strong awareness of SDLC, production change governance, release management, testing, risk assessment, rollback planning, and operational readiness.

• Experience with monitoring platforms such as Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds, Cacti, or similar tools.

• Experience conducting infrastructure architecture reviews and developing mitigation plans for technical and operational risks.

• Strong vendor management, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, documentation, written, and verbal communication skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

• Experience working in a Data Center operator or other mission-critical infrastructure environment.

• Exposure to OT environments supporting critical infrastructure, including Data Center automation, BMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar operational technologies.

• Knowledge of OT/ICS security principles and industrial cybersecurity practices.

• Experience with public cloud, hybrid cloud, software-defined networking, infrastructure automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, or DevSecOps practices.

• Experience with Zero Trust, SIEM, SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, or security monitoring platforms.

• Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

**Preferred Certifications**

• CISSP, CISM, or equivalent information security certification.

• Microsoft infrastructure, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), OT/ICS security, or Six Sigma/process improvement certifications.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Waystone is a leading provider of institutional governance, administration, risk and compliance services to the asset management industry. With over 25 years’ experience, we support many of the world’s largest asset managers, providing a comprehensive range of specialist services from a global network of offices.
  
  
The Platform Engineering team builds and operates Waystone’s engineering platform, spanning cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, on-call and our internal developer portal. We provide the secure, automated foundations that the firm’s regulated services run on. We are looking for a Platform Engineer to help scale this platform through standardised, automated and compliant patterns, accelerating delivery for our development delivery teams while raising operational resilience across the estate.
  
  
We are a cross-skilled team by design: rather than narrow specialisation, we want every engineer able to work across the platform, giving us broader coverage, resilience and shared ownership.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Take ownership of larger, moderately complex pieces of platform work, setting objectives and delivering against project goals with a direct impact on team results.
* Design, implement and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure patterns and reusable Terraform modules across Azure, AWS and OCI, with a primary focus on Azure.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) libraries to ensure consistent, compliant and repeatable environments across all cloud providers.
* Build and support CI/CD and deployment automation using GitHub Actions, Octopus Deploy and ArgoCD, and configuration management using Ansible and Octopus Deploy.
* Support and enable development delivery teams – provisioning autonomous environments and reducing deployment friction while maintaining guardrails and separation of duties.
* Provide operational support for containerised and micro-service workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), maintaining high availability and reliability.
* Manage core infrastructure lifecycle tasks – vulnerability remediation and patching, upgrades, scaling and decommissioning across the Windows and Linux estate.
* Drive the adoption of cloud governance policies, security standards and architectural best practice, and help maintain continuous compliance evidence against the firm’s obligations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DORA).
* Contribute to observability and monitoring across the estate, and to incident response and on-call, including troubleshooting and root cause analysis that drives systemic improvement.
* Support disaster recovery testing to validate recovery plans and ensure rapid, reliable restoration of services.
* Identify and recommend improvements to systems, processes and infrastructure patterns to improve operational resilience, performance and cost efficiency.
* Explain and advocate technical approaches to development delivery teams and colleagues across IT, influencing platform practices and standards at an operational level.
* Provide guidance, code review and support to junior engineers, helping them develop across the platform.
* Document infrastructure blueprints, standards and standard operating procedures in Confluence and our internal Platform Portal to enable self-service.
* Participate in the on-call rota to support critical infrastructure services.

**Essential Knowledge & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (e.g. B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with a minimum of three years’ experience as a Platform Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, DevOps Engineer or similar role.
* Strong experience designing and implementing infrastructure in Azure and AWS.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
* Experience building and debugging CI/CD and deployment pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, Octopus Deploy, Azure DevOps or similar).
* Strong Windows OS management in cloud environments; solid Linux fundamentals (deeper experience a plus).
* Proficient in a scripting language such as PowerShell, with experience automating operational workflows.
* Sound understanding of cloud security principles, identity and access management (Entra ID / IAM) and network security.
* Understanding of application architectures and CI/CD workflows, and how infrastructure aligns with them.
* Experience working closely with development delivery teams in an agile environment, using tooling such as Jira and Confluence to manage and track work.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
* AI-literate, with the ability to adopt and apply AI-assisted engineering tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, AI coding assistants and agents) to accelerate delivery, automation and documentation, and a willingness to keep pace with an evolving AI toolset.
* Able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams – balancing project delivery, BAU and support commitments – prioritising effectively and working independently across competing demands.
* Comfortable collaborating with UK-based colleagues across time zones as part of a global team.
* Able to participate in the on-call rota – on-call is a requirement of this role.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience operating in a regulated financial services or otherwise highly governed environment.
* Certification in Azure, AWS or DevOps practices.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (AKS), ArgoCD and containerised services.
* Experience with Ansible for configuration management and DR tooling.
* Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost-management best practice.
* Experience integrating AI or agentic tooling into engineering workflows (e.g. IaC generation, automated remediation, or documentation).
* Exposure to compliance-evidence or governance tooling and incident-management tooling.

Additional Information
  
  

* Participation in the on-call rota is a requirement of this role; standing on-call allowances apply.
* Opportunities for professional growth, including certifications in Azure, AWS and DevOps practices, within a deliberately cross-skilled team.
* You will join a global, collaborative team that values innovation, ownership and continuous learning, with a direct impact on the resilience of the firm’s platforms.

title: Digital Technology Advisor - Application Operations Engineering
description:
**Do you enjoy working with cutting-edge technology?**
**Would you like to help shape the future of our global energy?**

**Join our team!**
Our Industrial & Energy Technology (IET) team provides industry-leading products and services that optimize the extraction, production and processing of energy. We help a diverse range of customers across the value chain to reduce operating costs and improve productivity. Our team is responsible for the assembly of high-quality and innovative products.
  
  
**Partner with the best**
HPC Cloud Architects’ primary responsibilities are to establish the approach for integrating information applications, projects and programs and ensuring alignment with business strategies and drivers, and priorities relevant to Baker Hughes High-Performance Computing (HPC) portfolio.
  
  
As a Cloud DevOps Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for:
  
  
  

* Architectural Design: Design and architect high-performance computing clusters and platforms on public cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). This includes selecting appropriate compute resources (CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs), storage systems, and high-speed networking solutions.
* Solution Implementation: Implement and deploy cloud HPC solutions using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Ansible. This involves configuring virtual networks, setting up distributed file systems (like Lustre, GPFS, or Ceph), and deploying cluster management and job scheduling software (e.g., Slurm, PBS).
* Performance Optimization: Conduct performance analysis and benchmarking to identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the HPC stack. Tune application code for parallel processing using paradigms like MPI (Message Passing Interface) and OpenMP, and optimize hardware and software configurations to maximize performance.
* Collaboration and Consultation: Work as a technical advisor to researchers, engineers, and data scientists, helping them migrate their workloads to the cloud, adopt best practices, and troubleshoot application-specific issues.
* Automation and Management: Develop and maintain automated solutions for provisioning, software deployment, monitoring, and scaling HPC resources. Implement robust backup, disaster recovery, and security protocols to ensure the integrity and availability of the systems.
* Strategic Planning: Stay current with emerging cloud and HPC technologies, influencing product roadmaps and developing strategic plans for the organization's cloud HPC adoption and growth.

**Fuel your passion**
To be successful in this role, you will have
  
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field with 10 + years’ experience
* Extensive experience with HPC system design and management, including hands-on experience with hardware (CPUs, GPUs, InfiniBand) and software (compilers, schedulers, parallel programming libraries).
* Deep understanding of parallel computing concepts and programming models (MPI, OpenMP, CUDA).
* Proficiency in performance analysis tools and techniques.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
* Knowledge of cloud services relevant to HPC, such as compute instances, high-performance storage, and networking.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
* Strong Linux/Unix system administration skills.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with distributed file systems (Lustre, GPFS, Ceph) and job schedulers (Slurm, PBS).

**Work in a way that works for you**
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
  
  
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive
  
  
**Working with us**
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Working for you**
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.
  
  
  

* Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Digital Technology Advisor - Application Operations Engineering
  
  
**About Us:**
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
  
  
**Join Us:**
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

description:

* Working knowledge of LLM evaluation methodologies, including evaluation datasets, regression testing, and frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, or LangSmith.
* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asynchronous programming, Python packaging, and testing frameworks.
* Basic frontend development knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with backend API development experience.
* Knowledge of Shell scripting, Linux fundamentals, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker.
* Exposure to at least one cloud platform such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Basic understanding of Infrastructure Security concepts, including vulnerabilities, patch management, security logs, IAM, and access controls.
* Awareness of responsible AI and security practices, including prompt injection, data leakage, hallucinations, bias, and content filtering.
* Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk, including the ability to write KQL or SPL queries for AI-assisted security detection and investigation.
* Basic understanding of Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and cloud security controls such as Network Security Groups (NSGs), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), IAM policies, and conditional access.
* Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Bicep for cloud-native AI service deployment and configuration.
* Exposure to data privacy and regulatory requirements applicable in India, including the DPDP Act and RBI IT Risk Framework, particularly in handling personal and sensitive data within AI systems.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management concepts, including CVE, CVSS, EPSS scoring, CISA KEV catalogue, and patch prioritization workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug LLM behavior across prompts, retrieval pipelines, and tool integrations.
* Ability to interpret evaluation metrics, application logs, and security telemetry to improve AI quality, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated ownership of AI solutions from prototype to production, including evaluation, observability, testing, and documentation.
* Strong learning agility and adaptability to evolving AI models, frameworks, tools, and development practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
* Certifications such as CISSP, Associate of ISC², CEH, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), CCSP, or Google Associate Cloud Engineer are preferred.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powered features, AI assistants, and intelligent automation solutions for Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) workflows.
* Build AI-driven capabilities for vulnerability summarization, log triage, remediation recommendations, security policy reviews, configuration assessments, and natural-language querying of security data.
* Develop scalable, responsive, and reusable frontend applications using React.js for AI-powered internal tools and dashboards.
* Build and maintain backend AI services and APIs using Python, with Java-based backend development wherever required.
* Integrate LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and open-source models into enterprise applications.
* Design and optimize prompt templates, system prompts, structured-output schemas, and function-calling workflows.
* Implement end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document chunking, embeddings, vector store integration, retrieval optimization, and response grounding.
* Develop AI agents and tool-calling workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Build evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, and regression test suites to measure LLM accuracy, hallucination rates, response quality, latency, and cost.
* Continuously improve prompt engineering and AI outputs through offline and online evaluations.
* Implement responsible AI and security controls, including prompt-injection protection, PII redaction, output filtering, rate limiting, audit logging, and access management.
* Integrate AI services with vulnerability scanners, ticketing platforms, SIEM solutions, monitoring tools, and other security infrastructure to enable automated workflows.
* Automate AI/ML operations activities such as data preparation, embedding refresh, evaluation runs, health checks, and monitoring using Python and Shell scripting.
* Test, debug, and optimize AI applications to ensure reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Maintain technical documentation, source code repositories, deployment artifacts, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with security, infrastructure, engineering, DevOps, and data teams to translate business requirements into practical AI-driven solutions.
* Apply infrastructure security principles and cloud security controls while designing and deploying AI services.
* Continuously explore emerging LLM models, frameworks, prompting techniques, and evaluation methodologies to improve solution quality and security posture.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Assistant General Manager - Infra and IT - SCO
description:
**Job Description**
Key responsibilities
  
  
Linux Administration
  
  

* Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot RHEL and Oracle Linux servers.
* Manage Linux systems across physical, VMware and cloud environments, including users/groups, sudo, SSH, systemd, cron, DNS, NTP and network configuration.
* Administer file systems, LVM, NFS, SAN/NAS connectivity and multipathing; troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk I/O, kernel and network issues.
* Perform OS hardening, vulnerability remediation, package/repository management using YUM/DNF and capacity planning.
* Develop Bash/Shell automation for health checks, operational tasks and reporting.

Oracle Database Administration
  
  

* Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot Oracle databases, including supported enterprise versions such as 12c/19c and later.
* Manage instances, schemas, users, roles, privileges, tablespaces, listeners, initialization parameters and database storage.
* Monitor and tune SQL performance using AWR, ASH, ADDM, Explain Plan, SQL Trace, wait events, SGA/PGA and session analysis.
* Manage RMAN backup, restore and recovery, database cloning/refresh, migrations and point-in-time recovery.
* Configure and support Data Guard, replication, DR architectures, ASM and RAC environments where applicable.
* Plan and execute Oracle Release Updates/security patching and troubleshoot archive log, corruption, storage and recovery issues.

PostgreSQL Database Administration
  
  

* Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot PostgreSQL databases and clusters.
* Manage roles, privileges, schemas, tablespaces, extensions and configuration files including postgresql.conf and pg\_hba.conf.
* Tune queries, connections, memory, locks, transactions, indexes, checkpoints, autovacuum and database/storage growth.
* Manage pg\_dump/pg\_restore, pg\_basebackup, WAL archiving and Point-in-Time Recovery.
* Configure and support streaming replication and HA solutions such as Patroni, repmgr or equivalent where implemented.
* Perform major/minor upgrades, migrations, refreshes and troubleshoot replication lag, deadlocks, blocking and table/index bloat.

Microsoft SQL Server Administration
  
  

* Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot Microsoft SQL Server databases.
* Manage databases, logins/users, permissions, database files, TempDB, SQL Agent jobs and maintenance activities.
* Configure and support Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, log shipping and replication where applicable.
* Manage full, differential and transaction-log backups and point-in-time recovery.
* Monitor and troubleshoot blocking, deadlocks, CPU/memory pressure, disk latency, waits and long-running queries.
* Perform query tuning, index/statistics management, SQL Server cumulative updates and integration with Active Directory authentication.

Backup, Recovery & Disaster Recovery
  
  

* Define and maintain database backup standards, retention, restore procedures and recovery runbooks.
* Coordinate with enterprise backup teams and regularly validate restore capability for Oracle, PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
* Participate in DR drills and validate RPO, RTO, replication status and application-consistent recovery.

Performance, Capacity & Availability
  
  

* Proactively monitor Linux and database performance across CPU, memory, disk, storage latency, network and SQL workloads.
* Perform capacity forecasting for database growth, tablespaces, file systems, transaction logs, WAL/archive logs and infrastructure resources.
* Work with application teams to optimize SQL and recommend scaling or configuration improvements.

Security, Compliance & Lifecycle
  
  

* Implement Linux/database hardening, least-privilege access, privileged/service account reviews and vulnerability remediation.
* Plan and execute Linux patching, Oracle Release Updates, PostgreSQL updates and SQL Server Cumulative Updates.
* Track end-of-support versions and develop upgrade/migration plans; support audit evidence and compliance closure.

Monitoring, Incident & Problem Management
  
  

* Configure proactive monitoring and alerts for availability, resource utilization, storage capacity, replication, backup failures, locks and database growth.
* Own troubleshooting of P1/P2 production incidents, perform RCA and drive corrective/preventive actions.
* Participate in on-call support for business-critical production systems.

Automation, Change & Documentation
  
  

* Automate repeatable activities using Bash/Shell, SQL, PL/SQL and PowerShell; Python/Ansible exposure is desirable.
* Follow ITIL change management, prepare implementation/rollback/validation plans and participate in CAB as required.
* Maintain server/database inventory, architecture/topology diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, backup/DR procedures, patch schedules and capacity reports.

**Qualifications & Competencies**
Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong hands-on Linux administration: RHEL / Oracle Linux, LVM, multipathing, NFS, SAN/NAS, systemd, SSH, TCP/IP, DNS, NTP and Shell scripting.
* Strong Oracle DBA skills: RMAN, Data Guard, AWR/ASH/ADDM, SQL tuning, patching, recovery, ASM; RAC knowledge preferred.
* Strong PostgreSQL skills: streaming replication, WAL, PITR, pg\_dump/pg\_restore, pg\_basebackup, Vacuum/Autovacuum, query optimization and upgrades.
* Strong Microsoft SQL Server skills: Always On, backup/recovery, SQL Agent, performance tuning, indexes/statistics, blocking/deadlock analysis and patching.
* Good understanding of VMware, storage, enterprise backup, Active Directory, networking, high availability, disaster recovery and cloud infrastructure.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical thinking, ownership, documentation, stakeholder communication and vendor coordination.
