Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
  
  
**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Observability Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Minimum of 7 years as a Consulting Architect or senior IT functional leadership experience
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Observability.
* Fleet and agent installation policies, and scalability considerations.
* Knowledge in deploying enterprise observability (Metrics and Logs) solutions at scale (Application performance monitoring (APM), User experience monitoring (UEM), Infrastructure optimization, Network visibility and monitoring).
* Experience leading observability projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience working with monitoring tools that integrate into service management.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)

**Bonus Points:**

* Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications
* Comfortable with Ansible, JavaScript, Terraform
* Experience working closely with a pre-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).
* Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.

title: MS Engineer L2, Middleware
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) is a developing engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational.
  
  
Through the proactive monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving of technical incidents and problems, the Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) is able to restore service to clients.
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to proactively review client requests or tickets and apply technical/process knowledge to resolve them without breaching service level agreement (SLA).
  
  
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) focuses on second-line support for incidents and requests with a medium level of complexity and focusses across two or more technology domains - Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications and / or Collaboration etc.
  
  
This role may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Proactively monitors the work queues.
* Performs operational tasks to resolve all incidents/requests in a timely manner and within the agreed SLA.
* Updates tickets with resolution tasks performed.
* Identifies, investigates, analyses issues and errors prior to or when they occur, and logs all such incidents in a timely manner.
* Captures all required and relevant information for immediate resolution.
* Provides second level support to all incidents, requests and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Communicates with other teams and clients for extending support.
* Executes changes with clear identification of risks and mitigation plans to be captured into the change record.
* Follows the shift handover process highlighting any key tickets to be focussed on along with a handover of upcoming critical tasks to be carried out in the next shift.
* Escalates all tickets to seek the right focus from CoE and other teams, if needed continue the escalations to management.
* Works with automation teams for effort optimization and automating routine tasks.
* Ability to work across various other resolver group (internal and external) like Service Provider, TAC, etc.
* Identifies problems and errors before they impact a client’s service.
* Provides Assistance to L1 Security Engineers for better initial triage or troubleshooting.
* Leads and manages all initial client escalation for operational issues.
* Contributes to the change management process by logging all change requests with complete details for standard and non-standard including patching and any other changes to Configuration Items.
* Ensures all changes are carried out with proper change approvals.
* Plans and executes approved maintenance activities.
* Audits and analyses incident and request tickets for quality and recommends improvements with updates to knowledge articles.
* Produces trend analysis reports for identifying tasks for automation, leading to a reduction in tickets and optimization of effort.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**Knowledge and Attributes:**

* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).
* Relevant certifications include (but not limited to) -

+ CCNP or equivalent certification
+ CCNA certification in must, CCNP in Security or PCNSE certification is good to have
+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
+ AWS Certified: Solutions Architect Associate
+ Veeam Certified Engineer
+ VMware certified Professional: Data Centre Virtualization
+ Zerto, pure, vxrail
+ Google Cloud Platform (gcp)
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (oci)
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - OS DB Migration for SAP NetWeaver 7.4
+ SAP Technology Consultant
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP HANA 2.0
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
+ IBM Certified System Administrator - WebSphere Application Server Network

**Required Experience:**

* Moderate level years of relevant managed services experience handling cross technology infrastructure.
* Moderate level knowledge in ticketing tools preferably Service Now.
* Moderate level working knowledge of ITIL processes.
* Moderate level experience working with vendors and/or 3rd parties.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. **React, TypeScript, Node.js, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL**

You should have experience taking meaningful ownership of a live multi-tenant SaaS product and be comfortable using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity without compromising engineering quality.

Strong communication skills, a practical approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment are essential.

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. * Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.

title: Senior Manager/ AVP – IT Infrastructure & Trading Technology
description:
Abans Financial Services Ltd. is a listed, diversified financial services company offering a comprehensive suite of solutions across broking, commodity trading, asset management, financing, and investment advisory. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company operates with a strong presence in both Indian and global markets, serving institutional, corporate, and retail clients. As part of the larger Abans Group, the company continues to expand its footprint by delivering integrated financial services and building robust technology platforms to support its growing client base.
  
  
**Profile : Senior Manager/ AVP – IT Infrastructure & Trading Technology**
**Location: Nariman Point, Mumbai**
**Industry Preference: Stockbroking, Capital Markets, Trading, Brokerage, and Financial Services.**
**Job Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced IT Manager with expertise in IT infrastructure, trading technology, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance within the stockbroking industry. The candidate should have hands-on experience with hybrid infrastructure, exchange connectivity, CTCL trading applications, vendor licensing, and applicable SEBI and exchange regulations.
  
  
The role is responsible for ensuring the availability, security, and resilience of IT infrastructure and trading systems while supporting business operations and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* IT Infrastructure & Operations
* Manage on-premise and cloud infrastructure, including servers, storage, networks, and virtualisation.
* Ensure system availability, performance monitoring, capacity planning, and timely issue resolution.
* Manage backups, Disaster Recovery (DR), Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and periodic DR drills.
* Oversee IT asset management, software licensing, upgrades, and infrastructure maintenance.
* Stockbroking & Trading Technology
* Manage trading infrastructure like leased line connections, servers, licenses, etc for NSE, BSE, MCX, NCDEX, and other applicable exchanges and segments.
* Manage and coordinate with CTCL vendors such as Greeksoft, Resolute, ODIN, XTS, or similar trading platforms for software licences, vendor agreements, renewals, terminal registrations, and exchange-related approvals.
* Oversee configuration of CTCL/NNF IDs, terminal IDs, Location IDs, user IDs, and IP mapping, as applicable.
* Coordinate trading application installations, upgrades, testing, mock trading sessions, and exchange-mandated changes.
* Ensure integration and smooth functioning of trading applications, RMS, back-office systems, and market data feeds.
* Monitor trading-system performance and coordinate with vendors and internal teams to resolve technical issues.
* Exchange Connectivity & Network Management
* Manage leased lines, dedicated connectivity, internet links, VPNs, and network infrastructure for exchange connectivity.
* Handle IP whitelisting, firewall rules, routing, terminal mapping, and connectivity activation with exchanges and vendors.
* Ensure network redundancy, backup connectivity, failover, and business continuity.
* Monitor network performance, latency, and connectivity issues affecting trading operations.
* Cybersecurity & Security Management
* Manage firewalls, VPNs, antivirus, endpoint protection, and network security systems.
* Coordinate SOC operations, security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability assessments, and patch management.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, access management, and security policies in line with regulatory requirements.
* Ensure timely resolution and documentation of security incidents and vulnerabilities.
* Regulatory Compliance & IT Governance
* Ensure compliance with applicable SEBI, exchange, and other regulatory requirements relating to IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and trading systems.
* Coordinate exchange inspections, IT and cybersecurity audits, and closure of audit observations.
* Maintain IT policies, SOPs, infrastructure documentation, access records, and compliance reports.
* Oversee DR/BCP compliance, technology risk management, and required regulatory reporting.
* Vendor & Team Management
* Manage CTCL, RMS, back-office, network, cloud, and cybersecurity vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance, support escalations, licence renewals, and service delivery.
* Lead the IT team, allocate responsibilities, and ensure timely resolution of critical issues.
* Coordinate with Operations, Compliance, Risk, and other departments to ensure uninterrupted business operations.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong experience in IT infrastructure, networking, servers, virtualisation, and cloud environments.
* Prior experience in stockbroking, capital markets, or financial services IT.
* Good understanding of CTCL trading applications and vendor licensing, including Greeksoft, Resolute, ODIN, XTS, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience managing & coordinating third party vendors and Endpoint Security solutions (Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Trend Micro, Symantec, McAfee, SentinelOne, etc.).
* Experience working with SOC operations, SIEM platforms, security monitoring, incident response, and threat management.
* Strong understanding of Cybersecurity frameworks, Zero Trust Architecture, Vulnerability Management, Patch Management, and Security Best Practices.
* Familiarity with RMS, back-office systems, market data feeds, and trading application integration.
* Knowledge of firewalls, endpoint security, SOC operations, vulnerability management, and cybersecurity controls.
* Understanding of SEBI and exchange IT, cybersecurity, DR, and BCP requirements.
* Experience in exchange audits, IT compliance documentation, vendor management, and incident resolution.
* Minimum 5+ years of team management/leadership experience.
* Prior experience in Trading, Broking, Capital Markets, Financial Services, or BFSI organisations is highly preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting multiple exchanges and trading segments in a stockbroking environment.
* Hands-on involvement in CTCL implementations, exchange mock tests, system upgrades, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with trading operations, RMS, clearing, depository, and back-office technology.

title: Senior Associate Cloud SRE - Azure & AWS
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Senior Associate Cloud SRE – Azure & AWS**
**Education: Any Graduate**
**Experience: 7+years**
**Location: Mumbai**
**Role Summary**
As a Site Reliability Engineer supporting multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure), you will manage complex operational challenges and escalations while implementing reliability best practices across production systems. You will work collaboratively with customer teams and senior engineers to ensure system stability, automate operational workflows, and maintain comprehensive observability. This is a delivery-focused role requiring both advanced technical execution and operational ownership across cloud platforms.
  
  
**Key Skills**

* Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, & VMware
* Monitoring & Observability: Azure Monitor, New Relic, Splunk
* Incident & Service Management: OpsGenie, ServiceNow, Incident Triage, Incident Response
* Reliability Metrics: MTTR (Mean Time to Resolve), MTTA (Mean Time to Acknowledge), SLI (Service Level Indicators), SLO (Service Level Objectives), SLA (Service Level Agreement)
* Database: Basic Database administration/troubleshooting
* Containers: AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service) & Docker.
* Operating Systems: Windows Server, Linux Server

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Tier 2 Multi-Cloud Operations & Managed Services**
**Azure Operations**

* Provide tier two support for Azure cloud environments
* Manage and update Azure Virtual Machine images
* Create and configure Azure Virtual Machines and Azure SQL databases
* Manage Azure Active Directory (AAD) identities, roles, and role-based access control (RBAC)
* Configure Azure Storage account policies and access controls
* Manage Virtual Networks, Network Security Groups (NSGs), and route tables
* Restore VM snapshots and database backups to lower environments
* Manage disk resizing and Azure Managed Disks optimization
* Implement Azure resource tagging and cost management
* Manage log archiving using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics
* PIM (Privileged Identity Management)

**AWS Operations**

* Provide 24x7x365 tier two support and escalation handling for AWS environments
* Patch and manage Amazon Machine Images (AMIs)
* Create and configure EC2 instances and RDS databases
* Manage IAM roles, users, and policies
* Configure S3 bucket policies and Access Control Lists (ACLs)
* Open and manage network routes (VPC, subnets, security groups)
* Restore snapshots and database backups to lower environments
* Increase disk sizes (EBS volumes) and manage storage optimization
* Implement proper tagging for environment identification and cost allocation
* Manage log archiving using CloudWatch Logs and S3

**Cross-Cloud Responsibilities**

* Handle escalations from tier one support with deep technical analysis across both platforms
* Provide root cause analysis for complex incidents in multi-cloud environments
* Implement consistent operational standards across AWS and Azure
* Support hybrid cloud connectivity and integration scenarios

**Reliability & Incident Management**

* Implement and maintain SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs across AWS and Azure in collaboration with senior engineers and customer stakeholders
* Lead tier two incident response and incident triage, performing advanced troubleshooting and resolution on both cloud platforms (ServiceNow, OpsGenie)
* Conduct thorough post-incident analysis with actionable remediation plans; track and improve MTTR and MTTA
* Reduce reactive work by improving runbooks, alert configurations, and standard operating procedures for both clouds
* Apply reliability engineering best practices with oversight and review
* Mentor tier one engineers during incident response across multi-cloud scenarios

**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments on AWS and Azure
* Automate complex operational tasks including patching, backups, and environment provisioning across both platforms
* Develop infrastructure automation using Terraform for multi-cloud environments
* Create scripts and tooling to eliminate manual toil and improve operational efficiency
* Implement Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates or Bicep for Azure-specific automation
* Follow established patterns and contribute continuous improvements
* Document automation processes for knowledge sharing across cloud platforms

**Containerization & Deployment**

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Sealed Air designs and delivers packaging solutions that protect essential goods transported worldwide, preserve food, enable e-commerce and digital connectivity, and help create a global supply chain that is touchless, safer, less wasteful, and more resilient. We strive to foster a caring, high-performance growth culture that will deliver consistent, sustainable profitable growth and accelerate our performance – a culture where accountability is clear and aligned, and where we reward business outcomes and impact. That culture guides everything we do, including how we partner with our customers and suppliers, how we attract and retain top talent, and how we create and deliver value to our stakeholders. In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com.
  
  
Senior Platform Engineer
  
  
Sealed Air is seeking a highly skilled and self-motivated Senior Cloud Platform Migration Engineer to assume ownership of critical cloud infrastructure supporting customer-facing digital services and connected manufacturing capabilities.
  
  
The successful candidate will stabilize, operate, document, and modernize an existing AWS-based platform ecosystem while helping drive the long-term strategic transition to Microsoft Azure. The role requires practical experience with AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, automation, infrastructure-as-code, Linux, security, and cloud platform operations.
  
  
This is not primarily an application development role. The candidate must understand enough about application hosting patterns to support infrastructure decisions, troubleshoot platform-level issues, and partner effectively with application teams, but application code ownership and long-term application modernization.
  
  
What are we looking for in you?
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud Platform Ownership
  
  

* Own the operational health, reliability, security, and lifecycle management of assigned cloud-hosted infrastructure platforms.
* Administer current-state AWS platform components including IAM, networking, compute, storage, platform services, encryption, and security controls.
* Support and maintain Cloud Foundry and BOSH platform infrastructure, including stemcells, releases, manifests, routing dependencies, certificates, and operational procedures.
* Manage platform patching, operating system lifecycle activities, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation, and related production maintenance activities.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, technical diagrams, and support procedures for inherited and future-state environments.

Azure Migration and Modernization
  
  

* Help lead infrastructure planning and execution for migration from AWS-hosted platform services to Azure-based target-state architecture.
* Assess current AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, Linux, networking, IAM, and platform service dependencies to define migration approach, risks, sequencing, and operational impacts.
* Design repeatable Azure infrastructure patterns aligned to enterprise standards, including identity, network, security, monitoring, backup, and operational support models.
* Partner with Jayaram's application team to ensure application workloads are migrated or modernized with a clear separation between application ownership and infrastructure platform ownership.
* Develop migration automation and validation patterns to reduce risk and improve repeatability across future transitions.

Why do we need you?
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, automation, or related infrastructure operations experience.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience, including operational support of production cloud infrastructure.
* Practical Azure knowledge and demonstrated ability to design or support cloud migration and modernization activities.
* Hands-on scripting and automation experience with Python and Shell/Bash.
* Experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, Linux administration, infrastructure automation, and cloud security practices.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation, and operational problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate independently in a partially documented inherited environment and convert ambiguity into structured technical action plans.
* Cloud Foundry administration experience, especially with self-managed or legacy platform environments.
* BOSH administration experience, including directors, stemcells, releases, manifests, and platform lifecycle management.
* Experience migrating workloads or platform services between public cloud providers, especially AWS to Azure.
* Experience with Azure landing zones, Azure networking, Azure identity, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure-native platform services.
* Experience administering self-hosted GitLab, including upgrades, runners, access controls, storage, backups, and migration to SaaS or alternate DevOps platforms.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, platform-as-a-service models, and modern application hosting patterns.
* Experience supporting industrial IoT, connected device, or manufacturing-adjacent cloud platforms.
* AWS, Azure, DevOps, security, or architecture certifications.

What are our core values
  
  
Integrity
  
  
Determined
  
  
Innovative
  
  
Collaborative

We have a very diverse and inclusive culture.We invest in developing our people. title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Senior Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)**
The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline’s data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms.
  
  
We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production.
  
  
If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline.
  
  
**Why this job’s a big deal**
As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently.
  
  
You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams.
  
  
This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
* Architect, govern, and scale enterprise-grade Terraform module registries and infrastructure-as-code strategies for GCP data and ML platform services.
* Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI.
* Drive platform upgrades, lead capacity planning, and design operational improvements across development, QA, and production environments.
* Develop reusable automation and internal tools using Python and Shell scripting.
* Apply infrastructure-as-code, change-management, security, and auditability standards to platform changes.
* CI/CD, GitOps & Self-Service Enablement
* Define the CI/CD enterprise architecture and build governed pipelines for Airflow DAGs, Dataproc jobs, BigQuery changes, ML pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure.
* Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows.
* Set the strategy for GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, or equivalent CI/CD and GitOps tooling to improve developer experience and time to production.
* Design and engineer scalable self-service frameworks that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls.
* Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation.
* MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations
* Architect and optimize production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining.
* Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies.
* Support model gateway and LLM platform capabilities such as LiteLLM, including model onboarding, access management, rate limiting, usage visibility, cost controls, and reliability improvements.
* Define and enforce repeatable enterprise standards for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage.
* Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities.
* Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
* Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services.
* Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Participate in on-call support, lead blameless root-cause analysis (RCAs), and enforce corrective and preventative actions.
* Architect IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows.
* Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains.
* Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads.
* Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues.

**Who You Are**

* Degree & Experience: B.Tech or B.E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant.
* Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes.
* Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments.
* CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
* Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities.
* Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies.
* MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.
* Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems.
* Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations.
* Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience operating LLM gateways or GenAI platforms such as LiteLLM, Tyk, or equivalent model-access layers.
* Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems.
* Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and FinOps for data and ML workloads.
* Experience applying SRE, security, networking, or compliance practices to cloud data and ML platforms.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**
We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on distributed systems, production incident management, performance optimization, and platform ownership rather than feature development alone.

* Own production stability and act as the L3/L4 escalation point for backend and middleware systems.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents, latency spikes, Kafka lag, database contention, and memory issues.

  .

* Optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexing, partitioning, connection pooling, and Redis caching for high-performance workloads.
* Build configurable, rule-driven workflows and high-performance backend services.
* Improve observability through logging, tracing, metrics, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Lead vendor knowledge transfer, take ownership of legacy codebases, and establish backend engineering standards.
* Mentor engineers on production debugging, distributed systems, and code quality.

Required Skills & Experience

* 6–8+ years of backend engineering experience, preferably in fintech, trading, or transaction-heavy systems.
* Strong hands-on expertise in
  **Golang**
  , including concurrency, context propagation, runtime behavior, and memory profiling.
* Strong production experience with
  **Apache Kafka**
  , including consumer groups, rebalancing, offset management, and lag diagnostics.
* Proven expertise in
  **PostgreSQL performance tuning**
  and database optimization.
* Experience troubleshooting live production incidents and driving permanent corrective actions.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, fault tolerance, and high-throughput APIs.
* Demonstrated ownership of non-functional requirements (NFRs), performance benchmarks, and production reliability.

Good to Have

* Experience with low-latency trading platforms, exchanges, or regulated financial systems.

description:

Job Category

Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.

* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Work competently across the existing frontend layer using Angular/TypeScript/React
**.**

Direct Responsibilities

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture decisions, particularly around API design, data layer, and system integration

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Experience Level: 8+ years**

* 7+ years with Java backend development at enterprise scale
* 5+ years with Spring Boot/Spring MVC in production environments
* Demonstrated good experience across the listed Technical skills.
* Familiarity with frontend integration using Angular/TypeScript/React
* Experience with legacy system refactoring to target architecture
* Active use of AI coding assistants in daily workflow

**Domain Experience**

* Banking, financial services, or similarly regulated enterprise environments preferred
* Experience in GCC or offshore delivery models advantageous
* Exposure to high-volume, high-availability backend systems

Technical Skills
  
  
**Required**
**Skill Group**
**Details**
**Core Java & JDK 21+**

* Modern language features – records, sealed classes, pattern‑matching, text blocks, and functional APIs (streams, Optional).
* Concurrency & Parallelism – virtual threads (Project Loom), Completable Future, Executor Service, Fork/Join, and basic lock/atomic primitives.
* JVM & GC tuning – G1/ZGC behaviour, heap‑dump analysis, JFR profiling, and module‑system (JPMS) usage.
* Logging / Instrumentation / Error Handling
* Build & Unit‑test foundation – Maven/Gradle multi‑module builds, JUnit 5 + AssertJ, static code checks (SpotBugs), and basic GraalVM native‑image awareness.

**Spring Ecosystem**

* Spring Boot 3.x – create micro‑service skeletons, auto‑configuration, actuator health‑checks, and simple security (JWT/OAuth2).,
* Spring Data (JPA/R2DBC) – entity mapping, query‑hint optimisation, reactive repositories, and transaction demarcation.
* Spring Cloud basics – service discovery (Eureka), API‑gateway pattern, externalized config (Config Server), and circuit‑breaker (Resilience4j).
* Either Spring Batch OR Spring MVC OR Spring Integration
* Spring Security– CSRF protection, OAuth2 resource‑server setup, basic role‑based access control, and token validation, zero trust, MTLS.

**Database & Data Access Engineering**

* SQL & query optimisation – complex CTEs, window functions, indexing strategies, and execution‑plan analysis (PostgreSQL/Oracle/MySQL).
* Database optimisation - (indexing, query plans). Understanding of partitioning
* ORM performance – JPA/Hibernate mapping, N+1 detection, second‑level cache, batch inserts/updates, and @QueryHints.
* NoSQL & caching – when to use MongoDB, GraphDB, Redis (session/Cache‑aside), basic data‑modeling, and TTL/eviction policies.
* Migrations & transactions – Flyway/Liquibase versioning, multi‑DB transaction handling (JTA), and isolation‑level choices.

**Design & Architecture**

* Clean / Hexagonal architecture – ports‑and‑adapters, dependency‑inversion, and keeping frameworks at the outer ring.
* Domain‑Driven Design basics – bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and idempotent processing.
* API‑first & contract – OpenAPI/Swagger spec authoring, versioning strategy, and consumer‑driven contract testing (Pact).
* Event‑driven patterns – Kafka or RabbitMQ producers/consumers, out‑box pattern, and basic saga (choreography) implementation.
* Security: Public Keys / Hash Concepts. Design around Access Control, Role Based security.
* Microservices design Pattern ex: SAGA Design pattern

Concepts like -Circuit breaker, load balancer, Reverse Proxy
  
  

* Integration Patterns, Enterprise Patterns, Application scalability (stateful & stateless), Microservices Patterns, Distributed Transactions
* Caching Strategies (Redis, CDN)

**DevOps**

* Containerisation & K8s – Docker multi‑stage builds, Helm chart basics, pod liveness/readiness probes.
* CI/CD pipeline – Jenkins/Argo CD job that runs unit, integration, and static‑analysis steps; artefact publishing. Pipeline-as-code (Jenkinsfile/YAML)
* Observability starter – expose Prometheus metrics, configure a basic Grafana dashboard, and ship structured logs to ELK.
* Runtime security, secret‑management (CyberArk / Hashicorp / equivalent)
* Canary/blue‑green release patterns

**Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Test‑pyramid implementation – unit (JUnit 5/Mockito), integration (Testcontainers), contract (Pact).
* Performance & load testing – JMeter script creation, baseline latency/SLO definition, simple analysis of results.
* Static analysis & coverage – SonarQube quality gate, JaCoCo coverage threshold, SpotBugs rule set.

**Frontend**
Proficient working within existing Angular/TypeScript/NodeJS/NPM frameworks.
  
  
**AI Tools**
Daily use of AI DevAssistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate implementation across all skill areas
  
  
Understanding of MCP and Agentic concepts and able to develop and design.
  
  
Experience with Prompt Engineering, codebase context and constraints of AI assistants
  
  
**Behavioral Skills**

* Sets technical direction for multiple squads and aligns it with business objectives
* Cross-functional collaboration across frontend, QA, DecvSecOps and infrastructure teams
* Balances speed, quality, and regulatory constraints in a fast-moving environment and is results oriented
* Ensures that security, data‑privacy, and regulatory requirements are baked in.
* Structured communication of technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders
* Adaptability to legacy and greenfield environments delivering modern, cloud‑native solutions.
* Leverages generative AI to boost productivity and foster a culture of experimentation

**Education Level:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

title: Sr. Application Architect
description:
**Description**
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team.
  
  
You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
* Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
* Familiarity with AI-DLC / AI-assisted software engineering, data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
**About us**

Triton Infotech works with large, diverse datasets for AI development and enterprise use. We bring together structured and unstructured data from many sources and prepare it for secure storage, evaluation and delivery.

**The role**

A hands-on engineering role. You’ll own the pipeline that turns incoming data into an organised, verified, usable repository, working directly with terabyte- to petabyte-scale data, storage hardware, cloud platforms and AI-assisted workflows. You should be as comfortable debugging a failed transfer at the command line as managing a NAS or designing a repeatable ingestion and quality-check process.

**What you’ll do**

* **Data collection and ingestion:**
  coordinate receipt of datasets from multiple partners in India and abroad, via disks, NAS shares, secure links, cloud buckets and hosted repositories, and build reliable bulk upload, download and sync workflows.
* **Centralisation and organisation:**
  consolidate incoming data into Google Workspace and cloud object storage (GCS, S3, Azure Blob) with clear directory structures, naming conventions, metadata catalogues and source-level inventories.
* **NAS and storage systems:**
  configure, run and troubleshoot network-attached storage (SMB, NFS, rsync, SFTP/SSH), including RAID, permissions, snapshots, disk health, throughput, backup and recovery.
* **Cloud infrastructure:**
  work across GCP, AWS and Azure (compute, object storage, IAM, CLIs, lifecycle policies, transfer tools, logging and cost controls), and choose approaches based on volume, security, performance and budget.
* **Systems work:**
  use Linux, shell scripting and Python to automate file handling, large transfers and transformations, and diagnose filesystem, network, memory and disk I/O bottlenecks.
* **File-format fluency:**
  inspect, validate, convert and extract data across PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV, JSON, XML, images, video, audio, archives, databases and engineering/CAD formats (DWG, DXF, STEP, STL, IFC).
* **Cleaning and QA:**
  find duplicates, corrupt or incomplete files, inconsistent metadata and missing records, using checksums, deduplication, schema validation, batch transformation and exception reports.
* **AI-enabled operations:**
  use Claude, ChatGPT and coding assistants to speed up scripting, classification, metadata extraction and QA, with proper review steps, and never share restricted data with external AI tools without authorisation.
* **Traceability and governance:**
  keep a record of every batch (when it arrived, where from, file count, size, format, changes made, access restrictions and delivery status), with least-privilege access, encryption and retention controls.
* **Operational ownership:**
  monitor ingestion jobs, maintain runbooks and dashboards, resolve transfer failures, coordinate with partners and the internal team, and deliver organised, verified datasets on time.

**What we’re looking for**

* Hands-on experience in data engineering, infrastructure, DevOps or systems administration, with large and varied datasets
* Strong Linux, Python and Bash skills
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and with large file transfers (rclone, rsync, cloud CLIs)
* Familiarity with NAS, file-transfer protocols, permissions and backups
* Careful, well documented and security-minded; able to own work end to end
* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science or a related field

**Nice to have**

* Experience with multi-terabyte or petabyte-scale repositories, Docker, Git, SQL or OCR / document-processing pipelines

title: SRE Engineer
description:
Role Overview
  
  
The selected SRE and DevOps professional will be responsible for maintaining highly available production systems, managing cloud infrastructure, improving observability, and supporting reliable deployment and operations practices. The role combines hands-on engineering with incident response, infrastructure automation, performance optimization, and continuous reliability improvement.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have experience working in production-critical environments where system availability, quick incident resolution, effective monitoring, and preventive engineering are essential.
  
  
Key Responsibilities1. Site Reliability and Production Operations
  
  

* Monitor production systems and maintain service availability, performance, and operational stability.
* Participate in production support and scheduled on-call rotations, including the resolution of critical incidents.
* Investigate system failures, perform root cause analysis, document post-incident findings, and implement preventive measures.
* Identify recurring operational issues and reduce manual intervention through automation.
* Improve service reliability using measurable indicators, service objectives, availability targets, and error-budget practices.
* Contribute to capacity planning, disaster recovery, high availability, redundancy, and failover strategies.
* Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering
* Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Work with cloud compute, storage, networking, access management, monitoring, and cloud-native services.
* Support containerized applications and manage Kubernetes-based infrastructure, including AKS, EKS, GKE, or equivalent platforms.
* Troubleshoot cluster health, application workloads, resource utilization, scaling, networking, and deployment-related issues.
* Work with Helm and other relevant deployment tools to maintain consistent application releases.
* Infrastructure Automation and DevOps
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Support automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployment processes.
* Work with Git-based development workflows, including GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, or equivalent platforms.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and improve deployment reliability through automation.
* Develop scripts using Python and/or Bash to simplify operational activities and eliminate repetitive tasks.
* Monitoring, Observability and Performance
* Build and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting solutions for production environments.
* Work with observability platforms such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Golden Signals(including Latency, errors, traffic, saturation), AWS CloudWatch, and GCP Cloud Monitoring.
* Apply the four Golden Signals—latency, traffic, errors, and saturation—to monitor service health and identify performance issues.
* Improve distributed tracing and establish meaningful alerts that reflect actual system health and user impact.
* Investigate performance bottlenecks across infrastructure, applications, networks, and distributed systems.
* Linux, Networking and Security
* Troubleshoot Linux-based systems and production infrastructure issues.
* Apply networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, SSL/TLS, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Follow cloud security best practices for identity and access management, network segmentation, and secrets management.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security improvements, and compliance-related activities in collaboration with relevant teams.

Technical Environment
  
  
The role involves cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Terraform, scripting, production support, monitoring, and modern reliability engineering practices. Experience with one major cloud platform is important, while exposure to multiple cloud environments can be beneficial.
  
  
Additional exposure to Go (Golang), OpenSearch, ELK Stack, AI/ML production platforms, Azure AI services, AI Foundry, RAG-based workloads, and enterprise observability frameworks would be advantageous.

description:

title: MS Technical Specialist - Linux-6
description:

title: Operating System Engineer
description:
Required Background and Prior Experience

We are seeking a hands-on engineer who has previously built and supported production healthcare software comparable to VerityOS.

1. Relevant healthcare product experience — mandatory

The candidate must have personally developed substantial components of a live U.S. healthcare product involving one or more of the following:

\* Practice management.

\* Medical billing and revenue cycle management.

\* EHR-connected patient engagement and operational workflows.

The product must have been used by real healthcare organizations. Coursework, prototypes, chatbot demonstrations, and internal proof-of-concept projects alone do not qualify.

2. Billing and RCM engineering experience — mandatory

The candidate must have hands-on experience implementing healthcare billing workflows, including:

\* Claim creation/submission and acknowledgment or rejection handling.

\* Electronic remittance or EOB processing and payment posting.

\* Denial management and accounts-receivable workflows.

\* Patient balances, adjustments, and reconciliation.

They must understand the distinction between charges, claims, payments, adjustments, and patient responsibility, and explain how their system prevented duplicate transactions and preserved financial history.

They do not need to have built every billing component independently, but must clearly identify the components they personally implemented.

3. EHR or healthcare-system integration experience — mandatory

The candidate must have delivered at least one production integration with an EHR, practice-management system, or healthcare clearinghouse.

Relevant experience includes approved APIs, FHIR, HL7, healthcare transaction interfaces, or secure data exchanges.

They must demonstrate experience with patient matching, synchronization, conflicting updates, failed transactions, and reconciliation. General API experience alone is insufficient.

4. Secure application architecture — mandatory

The candidate must have implemented:

\* Role-based permissions and server-side access controls.

\* Audit trails and sensitive-data protection.

\* Separation of customer organizations’ data.

\* Secure credential management.

\* Backup, recovery, monitoring, and incident handling.

Experience with a platform serving multiple independent practices or customer organizations is strongly preferred.

5. Hands-on full-stack development — mandatory

The candidate must be able to personally design databases, develop backend services and user interfaces, write meaningful tests, deploy applications, and troubleshoot production issues.

This is a building role, not solely a project-management, consulting, or architecture role.

6. Production ownership — mandatory

The candidate must have supported a product after launch, including resolving incidents, releasing upgrades, managing database changes, and maintaining integrations.

They should be able to describe a significant production failure, its impact, how it was resolved, and what was changed to prevent recurrence.

7. Workflow automation experience — mandatory

The candidate must have built workflows involving task assignment, statuses, deadlines, escalation, document handling, and external-system events.

They must understand how to handle retries, duplicate events, incomplete information, and human review.

8. AI and communications experience — strongly preferred

Preference will be given to candidates who have deployed:

\* AI document extraction with validation.

\* Tool-using AI agents with defined permissions and human handoff.

\* Voice agents or telephony integrations.

\* Two-way SMS, e-fax, or secure patient messaging.

Candidates must distinguish production deployments from experimental projects.

9. Patient-facing and specialty experience — preferred

Relevant additional experience includes patient portals, caregiver access, scheduling, authorization workflows, procedure-resource scheduling, infusions, or other specialty-practice operations.

Neurology experience is valuable but not mandatory.

Evidence required with the application

Please provide two relevant project examples. For each, describe:

\* The product and type of healthcare organization it served.

\* Whether it reached production and how long you supported it.

\* Your exact role and the components you personally built.

\* EHRs, clearinghouses, or communications systems integrated.

\* The scale of deployment, where disclosure is permitted.

\* A difficult technical problem and how you resolved it.

\* A professional reference who can verify your contribution.

Confidential client names may be withheld initially. Use anonymized descriptions and synthetic data; do not disclose patient information or proprietary code.

title: Manager - Cloud Operations Lead
description:
****Job Summary****
At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “
**Create your own sunshine**
”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
  
  
****Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?****
As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
  
  
****Job Summary:****
We are looking for a hands-on Cloud Operations Lead to run the day-to-day operations of our AWS-primary cloud estate (with a fast-growing Azure footprint) and to own and drive DevSecOps across the organisation. Reporting to the Cloud Architect within the Cloud CoE, the role spans three areas: cloud operations (about half the role), cloud-security remediation (about a quarter), and DevSecOps ownership, adoption and governance (about a quarter). In practice that means running the reliability and cost-efficiency of the cloud estate, closing security findings and hardening the environment, and owning the DevSecOps toolchain while driving its adoption and governance across delivery teams. It is a deeply technical, execution-focused role for an engineer equally comfortable in infrastructure-as-code, pipeline security, incident response, and directing a managed-services partner pool.
  
  
On the operations side, you will operate and continuously improve the landing zones, networking, and platform services designed by the Cloud Architect — primarily on AWS, and increasingly on Azure as that estate grows. You will run monitoring and observability, drive incident, problem, and change management to resolution, and enforce operational guardrails, patching, and backup/DR routines across environments. You will act as the operational owner of the NTT DATA cloud and DevSecOps managed-services pool, holding the partner to SLAs and quality standards.
  
  
On the security and DevSecOps side, you will remediate cloud-security findings and harden the estate, and own the DevSecOps toolchain and practice end-to-end — building and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets-scanning, and image/container security into the delivery flow, and shifting security left. You will define secure-pipeline standards, onboard and enable delivery teams, and actively drive DevSecOps adoption and maturity across the organisation, in line with CISO requirements. Across both halves of the role you will maintain infrastructure-as-code, automate operational toil, support cloud cost/FinOps optimisation, and work within the architecture standards and guardrails set by the Cloud Architect and the Enterprise Architecture Review Board (EARB), escalating design changes rather than making them unilaterally.
  
  
**Areas Of Responsibility**
**Area of Responsibility**
****Responsibilities****
**Cloud Operations & Reliability (~50%)**
Operate and maintain the AWS-primary cloud estate (and growing Azure footprint) for reliability and availability against agreed SLOs.
  
  
Own monitoring, alerting, and observability across infrastructure and platform services.
  
  
Drive incident, problem, and change management to timely resolution, including on-call/major-incident response.
  
  
Operate landing zones, networking, and platform services within the guardrails set by the Cloud Architect.
  
  
Maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform primary; CloudFormation / Bicep / ARM) to provision and change environments consistently.
  
  
**Automation & Platform Engineering**
Automate operational toil across provisioning, monitoring, and scaling.
  
  
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform deployments in collaboration with DevOps/DevSecOps.
  
  
Perform operational debugging, root-cause analysis, and performance tuning; document runbooks and share operational knowledge.
  
  
Operate backup, restore, and disaster-recovery routines; verify recoverability and data availability.
  
  
Implement and maintain configuration management and environment consistency across dev, test, and production.
  
  
Maintain platform health across integrated components and dependencies.
  
  
Track operational metrics and keep stakeholders informed of service health and incidents.
  
  
**Cloud Security Remediation & Hardening (~25%)**
Implement and operate cloud security and DevSecOps controls in line with CISO requirements.
  
  
Own the cloud-security remediation backlog: triage findings from CSPM, Security Hub / Defender, and CISO reviews, and drive them to closure within SLA.
  
  
Apply patching, hardening, and encryption/key-management routines across the estate.
  
  
Remediate vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across accounts/subscriptions; harden baselines and prevent regression.
  
  
Continuously monitor cloud posture (CSPM) and report remediation status, risk burn-down, and exceptions to the CISO office.
  
  
Ensure controls and remediation evidence are audit-ready (GxP, GDPR, HIPAA); support security reviews and audits.
  
  
**Scalability and Performance**
Optimise platform performance, scaling, and resource utilisation against SLOs.
  
  
Perform capacity planning and autoscaling configuration for cloud workloads.
  
  
Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks; right-size resources for cost and performance.
  
  
**DevSecOps Ownership, Adoption & Governance (~25%)**
Own the DevSecOps toolchain end-to-end and integrate security scanning (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, IaC scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Embed image/container and Kubernetes security (registry scanning, admission controls, policy-as-code) into the delivery flow.
  
  
Define secure-pipeline standards and reusable templates; maintain release hygiene for continuous, safe delivery.
  
  
Drive DevSecOps adoption across delivery teams: onboard projects, run enablement, and track maturity uptake.
  
  
Establish and report DevSecOps KPIs (pipeline coverage, scan pass rates, mean-time-to-remediate, adoption %).
  
  
Manage secrets, keys, and certificates and enforce supply-chain security (SBOM, dependency and artifact integrity).
  
  
Own DevSecOps governance: define policy, standards, and gates in coordination with the CISO and EARB, and enforce them across teams.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Vendor Oversight**
Own the NTT DATA cloud managed-services pool: assign work, hold to SLAs, and review quality.
  
  
Track operational best practices and drive continuous improvement of run processes.
  
  
Propose and implement automation and tooling improvements to reduce toil and cost.
  
  
Pilot operational tooling (monitoring, FinOps, automation) with the Cloud Architect’s endorsement.
  
  
Feed operational insights back into architecture and standards via the Cloud Architect / EARB.
  
  
**Stakeholder Collaboration, Communication and Reporting**
Interface with application, infrastructure, and business teams to understand operational needs.
  
  
Coordinate with external partners, vendors, and technology providers on operational delivery.
  
  
Coordinate cross-functional teams during incidents, changes, and releases.
  
  
Ensure operations meet agreed service levels and business expectations.
  
  
Clearly communicate service health, incidents, and root causes to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Provide regular operational reporting (availability, incidents, cost) to the Cloud Architect and management.
  
  
**Operational Delivery & Run Management**
Own operational delivery of the cloud run function, including SLAs and service reviews.
  
  
Ensure operational commitments are met within agreed timelines and budget.
  
  
Manage the managed-services pool and schedules for operational execution.
  
  
**Travel Estimate**
**Job Scope**
**Internal Interactions (within the organization)**
Function Heads, business vertical leads/end users , procurement , SUN Infrastructure Teams (Network, Server, Database, Security), vendor payment, commercial, SAP support & other as necessary
  
  
**External Interactions (outside the organization)**
OEM, SI’s others partners/vendors/service providers in the space as applicable
  
  
**Geographical Scope**
Global
  
  
**Financial Accountability (cost/revenue with exclusive authority)**

* Cost Management:
* Execute cloud cost/FinOps optimisation: right-sizing, reserved-capacity actions, and waste elimination.
